title: [Sylvarraend Road]
description: A large granite boulder, apparently fallen from the mountain's craggy cliffs in some distant age, lies beside the cobblestoned road.  Surrounded by a thick stand of monir trees, the boulder provides a convenient resting place for travellers, and a brief respite from the rigors of the journey.

title: [Sylvarraend Road, Boulder]
description: From the top of the smooth boulder, the view of Ta'Illistim's famed spires is breathtaking.  Reaching towards the sky as if they were attempting to pluck the stars from the heavens, the lapis tiles glitter in the moonlight.

From the top of the smooth boulder, the view of Ta'Illistim's famed spires is breathtaking.  Reaching towards the sky as if they were attempting to pluck the stars from the heavens, the lapis tiles glitter in the day's light.

title: [Sylvarraend, Wooded Trail]
description: Two large oaks stand sentinel on either side of the widening trail, gentle keepers and old warriors.  Several dark red rosebushes grow around the bases of the trees, their tenacious arms winding around the trunks, cascading garnet-hued blooms overhead in drifting masses.

Two large oaks stand sentinel on either side of the widening trail, gentle keepers and old warriors.  Several dark red rosebushes grow around the bases of the trees, their tenacious arms winding around the trunks, cascading garnet-hued blooms overhead in drifting masses.  A sturdy treehouse has been built between the two oaks, spanning across the path.  A knotted rope dangles a few feet from the ground to the side of the path.

title: [Willow Hall, Treehouse]
description: Built from darkly stained planks, this treetop observatory is built between two large oaks, spanning across the grassy trail below.  The steeply pitched roof overhangs the platform to provide shelter for a round maoral door.  An old sylvan doorkeeper is perched precariously on the wooden railing.  A small brass bell is mounted besides the door, allowing visitors to announce their presence.

title: [Glo'antern Moor]
description: Something has disturbed the grasses at this point in the trail, and although the way is obvious to the west, it is totally indiscernible in the other direction.  The heavy mists do not help matters, limiting vision to twenty yards at best, and the wet grass seems to be especially tall all around.  A dark obsidian boulder perhaps ten feet high sits nearby, its surface scarred and deeply gouged by implements unknown.

title: [Glo'antern Moor, Boulder]
description: The view from atop this boulder is not spectacular by any means.  The monotonous grassland spreads out all around.  After about thirty yards of this same scene, mists choke off the view entirely, encasing the area like a grey dome.  Pockets of water dot the surface of the boulder, and footing is a bit tricky on the slick surface.  The trail runs off straight and true to the west from below the boulder, and here, on the boulder's top, the trail in the other direction becomes readily apparent.

title: [Frith's Inn, Front Desk]
description: The front room of this unassuming inn imparts a sense of warmth and comfort.  Serving wenches carrying trays of food and drink to rooms throughout the hostelry cast a welcoming glance at you as they pass.  Laughter and the sound of good fellowship reach your ears from the direction of some swinging doors.  At the mahogany front desk, the friendly proprietor stands ready to attend to your needs.

title: [Frith's Inn, Second Floor]
description: You are on the second floor of the inn.  As you lean over the polished modwir railing that surrounds the open landing, you see the front room below.  The stairway continues up and down here.  To the east is an oak door and to the west a teakwood door bearing a brass plaque.

title: [Zeltoph Switchbacks]
description: Bits of cloth are stuck to the rock wall where others have boldly climbed up to a ledge that shadows the trail.  Huddling under the ledge would also provide protection from the occasional showers of rocks that rain down from above.

title: [Zeltoph Mountain, Ledge]
description: Blackened rocks show evidence that others have stopped here to take a break from the arduous trail.  In the distance, foothills of the great mountain, Zeltoph, are barely visible.

title: [Zeltoph Switchbacks]
description: The trail to the south is wider than the path leading westward.  Below, it snakes around the mountain with a ledge jutting out midway between here and the level below.

title: [Zeltoph Mountain, Ledge]
description: Blackened rocks show evidence that others have stopped here to take a break from the arduous trail.  In the distance, foothills of the great mountain, Zeltoph, are barely visible.

title: [Solhaven, Limpet Trail]
description: A solid wall of close-planted evergreens reaches well past the top of the courtyard wall of the manor nearest the corner.  In sharp contrast, the rest of the estates along here have limited themselves to a few widely separated trees growing taller than -- and well away from -- their protective walls.

title: [Solhaven, Dark Tree]
description: The branches of the ancient black willow tree twist about themselves, offering numerous locations throughout for comfortable seating.  Graceful black leaflets attached to long dark green stems shimmer a shadowy black as they rustle against the rough bark of the tree.  A faint rattling sound can be heard emanating from within the core of the tree.

The branches of the ancient black willow tree twist about themselves, offering numerous locations throughout for comfortable seating.  Graceful black leaflets attached to long dark green stems rustle against the bark of the tree, and a very fine pollen lingers in the air about you.

title: [Solhaven, Liabo Esplanade]
description: Moonlight softly illuminates the crowded flowerbeds forming the northern border of the avenue.  Saffron snapdragon compete with bright yellow daffodils and golden sunflowers, forming a wall of living color and greenery.  A pair of golden sandstone pegasi kneel to either side of a brick walkway that leads north beyond the flowerbeds.  Tall boxwood hedges line the south side of the esplanade, parted by a broad tiled path leading south.

title: [Solhaven, Light Tree]
description: The branches of the ancient linden tree twist about themselves, offering numerous locations throughout for comfortable seating.  Five-petaled golden flowers and verdant leaves gently rustle against the soft bark of the tree, and the sweet fragrance of nectar permeates in the air around you.

The branches of the ancient linden tree twist about themselves, offering numerous locations throughout for comfortable seating.  Five-petaled flowers shimmer softly with a golden glow and verdant leaves gently rustle against the soft bark of the tree.  A soft, gentle hum can be heard emanating from within the core of the tree.

title: [Krodera Street]
description: The walls of the canyon loom overhead.  The street continues inside them to the east, entering a vast, dimly-lit tunnel.  Dwarves and other folk wander in and out, some stopping at a small, bright-blue wooden shop here outside.  A thick plume of black smoke puffs silently out of the shop's chimney and the faint smell of burning bread wafts throughout the street.

title: [Stone Steps]
description: A flight of steps has been carved into the face of the cliff, winding up its face in a dizzy ascent.  A handrail follows its progress, with torches stuck into the cliff wall lighting the way.  Nearby, a finger of rock sprouts from the canyon floor and lifts toward the sky like an igneous flower following the moon's beckoning.  High above, on top of the column where it flares amid low clouds, the outline of a large structure can barely be glimpsed.

High above, on top of the column where it flares amid low clouds, the outline of a large structure can be glimpsed.

title: [Stone Steps]
description: The steps are steep and they twist up the cliff's face in a lazy S-curve like the trail of a snake climbing a desert dune.  Along the cliff-side of the flight, knobs have been carved in the form of sand devil heads that support a rudimentary handrail crafted of teak.  The rail passes through the sand devils' bared teeth, leaving one to worry that the monsters will at some point grow tired of their burden and spit the rail out.

title: [Glaes and Dragonstail]
description: The tunnel turns here, as Glaes and Dragonstail meet.  One building stands out, a large, black granite structure.  A staircase of grey and white marble leads up to the mithril gates, which are flanked by a pair of stone manticores.  The dwarves who amble in and out look to be prosperous sorts.

title: [Stormbrow Gallery, Lobby]
description: Sunlight filters in throught the gates, glittering off a wide staircase that leads upward, spiraling round and round beneath the enormous, glass dome ceiling.  The room is quite spacious, and though sparsely decorated, exudes a sense of elegance and respect.

The moonlight adds an ethereal glow to the torchlight in the room.  A wide staircase leads upward, spiraling round and round beneath the enormous, glass dome ceiling.  Even at night, the sparsely decorated room exudes a sense of elegance and respect.  A seemingly endless blue-black sky glitters with the hundreds of white starstones that dangle from the ceiling far overhead.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Entrance]
description: Six glowing orbs light a concave wall of pure white drakar speckled with red that encompasses this well-lit antechamber.  The floor is crafted from hardened lava, leveled and polished smooth.  A thick bronze seal is set deeply into the floor, facing an obsidian archway that leads to the tunnels of Kharam Dzu.  Opposing the archway, a flagstone stairway curves in wide, angular sections as it descends.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Stairway]
description: Short flagstone steps curve east to north from the hall's entrance and widen significantly as they drop to the floor of an expansive refectory.  Four statues, depicting a sand devil, a siren lizard, a thrak, and a pyrothag, rest upon heavy bronze pedestals set back into the smooth, grey stone walls on either side.  Yellow-green light filters from above and below, dimly lighting the stairway as it reflects off the walls.

title: [Greymist Wood]
description: Boles of trees loom up into a thick jungle canopy like smooth-skinned towers on all sides.  At places on the trunks, epiphytes cling with loopy, tangled root systems, their gaudy flowers displaying color that even manages to penetrate the darkness.  A cacophony of sound rises from frogs and other invisible creatures prowling in the dank heart of the foliage.  East of the trail, a huge strangling fig tree lifts its branches toward the moons, their leaves covered with a lacework of vines and mosses.

Boles of trees loom up into a thick jungle canopy like smooth-skinned towers on all sides.  At places on the trunks, epiphytes cling with loopy, tangled root systems, their broad leaves and gaudy flowers creating a riot of color in the green twilight.  A cacophony of sound rises from birds, insects and invisible creatures prowling in the dank heart of the foliage.  East of the trail, a huge strangling fig tree lifts its branches toward the sky, their leaves covered with a lacework of vines and mosses.

title: [Greymist Branch]
description: A wide branch extends east from the bole of the ficus tree, its girth as wide as a road.  Fringes of liana vines give it a veiny look, as if the smooth surface of the tree is covered with skin stretched over its lattice of blood vessels.  Night birds dart among the verdure, squawking and filling the canopy with shadowy movement.  A tangle of vines hangs down from higher branches, providing a busy highway to long streams of ants and other insects.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Chamber of Wind]
description: Hot air, rushing in from the northwest, forms a violent vortex that ascends a smooth walled, circular chimney.  Laden with ash, the vortex limits visibility while creating a roaring growl that could drown out all but the loudest of sounds.

title: [Eye of V'Tull, Chimney Flue]
description: Hot ash swirls in a violent vortex that continues to rise up the narrowing flue.  A small ledge of crystal provides some protection from the tempest, as well as pulses of abnormal light.  A strange sense of power permeates the chimney, swirling and eddying with the currents of the tempest.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Ruined Cavern]
description: It would appear that a catastrophe once occurred in this foul smelling chamber.  The eastern wall has been caved in, burrowed through by something large enough to leave the floor strewn with glaesan boulders in its wake.  Despite the destruction, several wooden beams still rise up to support the ceiling above, and the iron scaffolding erected along the other walls looks unscathed.

title: [Abandoned Mine, Scaffolding]
description: This scaffold rises against the ruined chamber's southern wall, much of which has been chipped away to reveal a thick vein of rainbow glaes.  If anything, the destruction of the room below looks worse from this height.  Large shadows shift unnaturally upon the ceiling, a disturbing sign that this mine is not wholly abandoned.

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: A large branch is tightly wedged against a massive tree that has been uprooted and is lying across the southern path.  Powdery snow and slippery ice cover everything, making every step an effort.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tree Path]
description: A snowy owl glides silently among the trees above the path, searching for a likely victim in the falling snow.  The ghostly figure suddenly dives, then rises--a tiny animal grasped in its talons--and quickly spirals up out of the trees and wings its way home.

title: [Icemule Trail, Snowy Forest]
description: A massive tree lies on its side across the trail -- branches piled against it to make it easier to clamber over.  You judge its girth to be about head high on a tall halfling -- or perhaps a bit higher.

title: [Icemule Trail, Tree Path]
description: A light snowfall has dusted the path that ends at the trunk of a massive, fallen tree.  Hardy lichen has taken root along the sides of the tree providing homes for the hardy northern bugs.

title: [Silvergate, Grand Hall]
description: Although large and open, this hallway manages to feel cozy.  Burgundy wool carpet covers the stone floors and a wide stone staircase with garland-trimmed bannisters which rises gracefully to the upper levels of this fine old manor house.  Carved oak display cases flank the foot of the stairs and fill most of the eastern wall.  Opposite the stairs, well-cushioned sofas and chairs are grouped around each of four large leaded glass windows.

Shadows dance across the onyx-tiled floor of this spacious room.  In the center of the room is a bed shrouded with a black and silver spidersilk veil suspended from the ceiling.  One long-stemmed blood red rose lies across the pillows.  A night stand of gleaming black onyx is carved in the shape of a wolf standing guard.  A silver-tipped scroll lays on a delicate mahogany writing desk, and a large mural on the west wall catches your eye.

Cut-crystal chandeliers brightly illuminate the hall, the light reflecting off tall leaded glass windows.  Plush cream damask sofas and chairs rest atop a crested rug.  Carved sideboards flank a magnificent fireplace under an oil painting of Silvergate Inn.  A sweeping grand staircase with lustrous mahogany banisters rises to the upper level, and elaborate bouquets of jasmine and golden roses artfully fill tall vases decorating the hall.  Liveried footmen and bellmen bustle about, attending to the guests.

Tall leaded glass windows allow light to stream in and reflect off the gold-veined marble floors.  Plush cream damask sofas and chairs rest atop a crested rug.  Carved sideboards flank a magnificent fireplace under an oil painting of Silvergate Inn. title: [Silvergate Inn, Observatory]
description: Spiraling stone steps open into a room with a glass-paneled dome overhead.  A massive steel-riveted telescope is mounted on a rotating plate controlled by a series of pulleys.  Long benches positioned before the paneled glass north wall afford a spectacular view of the town and surrounding environs.  A large teak table curves along the south wall beneath framed constellation images.

title: [Land Tower East, Office]
description: The ground floor of this guard tower appears to be some kind of office.  A single guard sits behind one of the desks reviewing some paperwork.  A small wood stove in the corner provides heat to the room.

title: [Land Tower East, Dormitory]
description: This room contains several wood cots with rough woolen blankets.  You can hear noise from the area outside the gate through slit-like windows on the northern wall of the room.

title: [Vornavis Cliffs, River Trail]
description: The roaring sound of the Cairnfang falling into the bay fills your ears at the top of the trail.  A group of huge boulders blocks any view of the river from here.

title: [Cascade of Tears, Promontory]
description: The view of the falls is breathtaking.  As the rushing river cascades over the cliff's edge, droplets of water mist the air and the moonlight refracts into a glittering curtain.  Yet for all its beauty, there is still a haunting sadness about this place.

The view of the falls is breathtaking.  As the rushing river cascades over the cliff's edge, droplets of water mist the air and the sunlight refracts into a brilliant rainbow.  Yet for all its beauty, there is still a haunting sadness about this place.

title: [Cysaegir, Disk Statue]
description: Thick vines of creeping clematis completely entwine the bole of a hemlock tree.  A curious looking relic rests beneath its spreading branches.  Revolving slowly on an invisible axis above a pedestal made of intricate stonework traceries is an oval-shaped disk of glass.  Relieving the darkness, alternating shades of purple, pink, and white light flash from within the depths of the disk.  The air and ground immediately surrounding the relic seems to shimmer and crackle with energy.

title: [Cysaegir, Top of Pedestal]
description: The air thickens from this vantage point on the pedestal, where alternating shades of paled purple, pink, and white light reflect from the disk above, struggling against the glare of the golden sun.  Like fingers of a blind man, hazy mist traverses the ground to obscure the form of a woman.  Loud creaking sounds, emanating from the warped rocking chair she rests in, are muted significantly by a droning sound like that of a thousand agitated cinder wasps.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Large Oak]
description: The broken path winds near a tall black oak of wide girth, seeming to pay the ancient tree homage as it passes.  Scored by deep creases, the black and grey bark of the giant oak bears testament to its age and tenacity.  This silent sentinel appears to gaze at its surrounding with a wary eye, ever watchful for those who would attempt to defile these woods.

title: [Great Oak, Platform]
description: Some thirty feet above the forest floor, a carefully camouflaged wooden platform has been built around the great oak.  Littered with a thin layer of leaves and dust, the platform has not been used in some time.  Even in the dim moonlight, gazing down over the edge provides an excellent view of the old path and intimate woods, while providing the looker with near invisibility among the thick oak branches.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: A faint rasping sound drifts through the still woods, its origin unclear.  Although the utterance sounds vaguely like speech, its exact intent seems just beyond comprehension.  As the dry whispering becomes lost within the shadow-mired forest, a heavy silence once again blankets the area.  A web of woven netting has been hung across a crook in the branches of a nearby oak tree.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Perch]
description: Strung between a pair of stout branches, the woven netting provides a camouflaged perch for observation of the crumbling path below.  Although torn in a few places and adorned with fallen leaves, the web of the netting is surprisingly intact.  Portions of the bark show signs of wearing, perhaps from the leaning shoulders of silent watchers who held vigil in this perch long ago.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: The massive girth of a great oak rises from the entangled undergrowth, like an imposing monolith of the dark woods.  Its bark has changed to a stone-like grey and has splintered into jagged cracks, littering the forest floor with thin shards of bark.  The trunk of the giant tree is twice the size of a normal cottage, its uppermost branches lost within the shadows overhead.  A collection of broken boards lies half-buried in the nearby undergrowth, and twin cords hang down from an especially hearty branch.

title: [Great Oak, Entry]
description: Some forty feet above the forest floor, an arch-like opening in the great oak provides a small sheltered landing.  Naturally rounded and wrinkled with age, the archway seems to have opened of its own accord, rather than by artificial means.  Although dusty and laden with dried leaves, the natural floor of the landing is evenly contoured.  A cracked wheel and spool of heavy cord are all that remain of an old pulley system.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: A massive oak, its wide girth dominating this small clearing, extends its finger-like branches toward the heavens.  Around its base, a cluster of pale cobblestones has been upturned, as if the roots of the large tree were clawing toward the surface.  The trunk has taken on a light grey hue, as if the tree itself were suffering from some unknown malady.  A thick woven cord, knotted in numerous places, dangles from some branch hidden in the heights of the old tree.

The trunk itself has taken on a light grey hue, as if the tree itself were suffering from some unknown malady.  A thick woven cord, knotted in numerous places, dangles from some branch hidden in the heights of the old tree.

title: [Outpost, Withered Cabin]
description: Cradled in the branches of the oak, this small cabin was crafted to fit within the natural contours of the tree.  Sheets of wood panel the walls and floor, but the roof has collapsed inward, littering the floor with piles of debris and leaves.  Sagging inward, the outer walls have been pierced by withered branches, and dark stains, perhaps from leaking sap, run down their surfaces.  Much of the room is blanketed in dust, but a small stove with a cracked vent pipe sits near an open trapdoor in the floor.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Ruined Hall]
description: Deep gouges mar the magnificent carvings lining the hall.  A tarnished axe blade remains buried in the neck of a drake carving.  One of the hall's support columns rests as rubble across the hall.  The column's elaborate capital remains intact, covered in animal filth.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Stairwell]
description: A wide crack travels the length of the stairwell while light from grates set into the walls above cuts through the gloom.  The musty smell of decaying plant matter makes the air heavy and unpleasant.

A wide crack travels the length of the stairwell while a small amount of light from the night sky filters through the grates set into the walls above.  The musty smell of decaying plant matter makes the air heavy and unpleasant.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Crags]
description: Finding footholds along this steep path is difficult, as it climbs nearly straight up into the DragonSpine Mountains.  You scramble to keep upright as loose rocks slip underneath your feet, and there is little to hold onto for balance.  The path seems to disappear into silvery mists above.  The downward direction looks somewhat safer, as you can see a rocky trail below that follows the mountain pass.

Finding your footing along this path is made difficult by the shadows moving across the area.  Loose rocks and earth further hinder efforts to climb further up the path.  Moonlight illuminates the silvery mist into which the path ascends.  Below, the rocky trail follows the mountain pass.

title: [Seethe Naedal, Crags]
description: The rocks provide a small resting place in the form of a narrow ledge jutting out from the sheer cliff.  Far below, the city of Ta'Illistim spreads eastward, the valley below it a blur of verdant green.  A large crevasse opens into the cliff's face.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Cavern]
description: Drifts of refuse have collected between stalagmites rising from the cavern floor, white bones visible amidst the less identifiable debris.  A sharp animal reek pervades the chamber, though its source is invisible in the greenish glow of luminescent fungi festooning the uneven ceiling.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chimney]
description: The only way to travel up or down within the smooth and featureless vertical passage is to brace hands and feet along its sides.  Your halting motion along the slick walls is uncomfortably reminescent of peristalsis.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chimney]
description: The cavern narrows abruptly to the north and ends in a pit little wider than a stout giantman's shoulders.  The rim of the pit is worn smooth, almost slick.

title: [Zaerthu Tunnels, Chimney]

title: [Twin Canyons, Canyon Junction]
description: Rubble from the collapsed eastern wall litters the ground while the rockslide rises over two hundred feet up the eastern end of the canyon.  The wall beyond the rubble is extremely jagged and appears to be unstable as small rocks are constantly falling free and joining their predecessors on the rockslide.  To the north the eastern branch of the twin canyons works its way around the rock outcrop that splits the pair, while to the west jagged rocks jut up amidst a covering of eerily dancing mist and steam.

title: [Twin Canyons, Rockslide]
description: Small rocks skip down the wall, making a clattering noise for several moments before finding a place to rest.  The remaining wall appears highly unstable and the source for the majority of rubble that comprises the rockslide.  Not far above, the rim of the canyon is visible against the silvery night sky.  Sloping steeply and containing many loose and jagged rocks, the wall beyond this point appears to be an impossible climb.

Sloping steeply and containing many loose and jagged rocks, the wall beyond this point appears to be an extremely dangerous climb.

title: [Badlands, Gully]
description: The gully abruptly meets a solid rock cliff face.  The cliff face slants inward a bit, and errant drops of water fall from the overhang.  The shadowy area under the cliff is slick with a thin layer of ice.

title: [Badlands, Hillock]
description: Atop a lonely hill sits a massive granite figure.  The great stone colossus sits astride the tumbled rocks of the mount like a king enthroned.  His reign has been a tragic one, and both feet, as well as his left arm, have long since crumbled away.  He sternly surveys the lands to the south, no doubt contemplating how to regain the lost glory of his dominion.

title: [Land Tower West, Roof]
description: A small overhang on the south side of the tower provides the on-duty guards with some shelter from the elements.  From there, you can see the roofs of the town buildings to the south and southeast.  Directly south, you can see a large open square among the buildings.  Your view east is blocked by another guard tower.  To the north, you can see the road that leads to the main gate of Wehnimer's and beyond it, to the shoreline.

To the north, you can see the road that leads to the main gate of Wehnimer's and beyond it, to the shoreline.  A large amber-tinted orb is set into a curved steel-bound glass shell.

title: [Land Tower West, Ladder Room]
description: A long wooden ladder connects this floor to the floors above and below.  A couple of crates and some old uniforms hanging on wall hooks are the only items in the room.

title: [Land Tower East, Dormitory]
description: This room contains several wood cots with rough woolen blankets.  You can hear noise from the area outside the gate through slit-like windows on the northern wall of the room.

title: [Land Tower East, Roof]
description: A small lean-to on the south side of the tower provides the on-duty guards with some shelter.  You can see the roofs of town buildings to the south and southeast.  To the east you can see two more guard towers, apparently sitting on either side of the river.  To the northwest, you can see the road that leads to the main gate of Wehnimer's and, beyond it, to the shoreline.

title: [Darkstone, Plateau]
description: Although the trees here have been leveled, their wood remains in the form of gruesome engines of war.  Most have been ravaged by enemies and time to the point of collapse, but one old siege tower still stands defiantly above the battlefield.  An uneasy awareness of death and decay fills you as you scan these twisted monuments to the long forgotten dead of the battle.  To the east of here lies the battered and abandoned remains of a once magnificent castle.

title: [Darkstone, Siege Tower]
description: Although time has taken its toll on this veteran machine, it remains extremely solid and secure.  It was once mobile, but its wheels have long since sunk into the mud and dirt below, making it a permanent feature here.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: A large oak desk sits prominently in the middle of this room; perhaps it was the office of the captain of the guards, or some similarly important post.  Tattered banners hang on the walls around the room, but they have long since faded and decayed beyond recognition.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: This round tower marks the intersection of the northern and eastern walls of the outer keep.  Although it was once patrolled by many strong guards, the tower is now home to only a few blades of grass which struggle to grow in the cracks between the stones.  The parapets run along the walls to the west and south here, and some steps lead down into the tower.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: Simple furniture once adorned this room, but it has now been reduced to splinters and dust.  The round stone walls seem firm enough, though, considering their age and use.  Light filters down from above through cracks in the roof illuminating the swirling dust in fingers of gold.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: The northern and western walls meet here to form a squat round tower.  Archers stationed here would have a clear shot along the bases of both walls to deter invaders, but no one has stood at these posts for ages.  A stone parapet extends along the tops of the walls to the east and south from here, and some steps lead down into the guardtower.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: A large block of stone, perhaps part of the inner tower, has collapsed the roof inward here, filling the room with shards of wood and stone, as well as the block itself.  Sunlight coming in from the now-open roof has warmed the rocks to a pleasant temperature, which gives you a bit of comfort from the chill which pervades the castle.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Guardtower]
description: You pick your way carefully around the edge of the top of the tower here, as most of it has plummeted down into the building below, filling the room below with rubble.  Some stone steps lead down to ground level from here, and the parapet extends along the tops of the walls to the north and east from here.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: This room is in surprisingly good condition.  The walls are solid and unbroken and there are even some furnishings in good repair to be seen.  Perhaps a guardroom or entry hall, it now seems to do duty as both a bedchamber and library.  A rough but servicable bed sits in one corner and a massively solid blackened oak table sits in the center of the room with some ancient leather-bound books upon it.  A woven tapestry hangs on the far wall, heavy and black as primordial sin.

title: [Shrine of the Jackal]
description: Once elegant, but now ruined, stained glass windows show this was once a chapel.  A smooth slab of obsidian seems to suck up all the faint light that falls upon it, and gives back only darkness.  On the slab, in sharp contrast, sits a statue carved of glittering crystal that bends and twists the few glimmers of light left into a mockery of beauty.  The question remains as to just what has been worshipped in here of late and you like not the thoughts it stirs.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Inner Keep]
description: The southeast tower of the castle appears to have collapsed entirely, although it is unclear whether this was due to damage or simply the ravages of time.  In either case, all that remains of the great tower now is a huge pile of rubble.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Crypt]
description: The air is still and silent in this dimly-lit space.  Several ornately carved stone coffins, probably containing dead ancestors of the castle's lords, lie under thick blankets of dust here.  A thick, swirling mist blankets this room almost completely, only briefly wavering to reveal a dark stone monolith towering silently in the center of the room.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: Large cracks in the walls here make you question the structural integrity of this tower.  Broken bits of stone and a fine rocky dust cover most everything in this room, what little there is.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: The entire top of the tower has been smashed and broken off here, just about at the level of your head.  Whether this damage was due to enemy aggression or to the long passage of time is not at all clear, but the thought of a massive stone tower falling, for any reason, makes you uneasy.

title: [Castle Darkstone, Tower]
description: Large cracks in the walls here make you question the structural integrity of this tower.  Broken bits of stone and a fine rocky dust cover most everything in this room, what little there is.

title: [Torture Chamber]
description: Gruesome instruments of torture fill this room, although most are now broken beyond repair.  The dampness of the castle walls here has promoted the growth of several molds, and a dank, musty smell hangs about the room.  The vague stench of death wafts up from cracks surrounding a trap door in the floor, filling you with dread.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Assorted rubble--dirt, bones, and other debris--has been dug up from the ground beneath the dungeon, revealing a network of tunnels.  Sections of the tunnel are wide, others narrow and in danger of imminent collapse.

title: [Darkstone, Dungeon]
description: Squatting precariously atop this immense pile of dirt, debris, and animal remains, you see a small, dark opening.  Soft, shuffling sounds travel through from above, making the tiny hairs at the back of your neck stand on end.

title: [Wehnimer's, Tunnel]
description: The walls of this low stone tunnel are covered with a glowing, grey lichen that makes your eyes strain and gives your skin an eerie, pallid cast.  The damp, close air is warmer here than you would have expected, but the lingering chill of the unknown stays with you.  A stone stairway, appearing to turn sharply, breaches one wall of the room.

The damp, close air is warmer here than you would have expected, but the lingering chill of the unknown stays with you.  A crumbled stone stairway, appearing to turn sharply, breaches one wall of the room.

title: [Wehnimer's, Tunnel]
description: The twisting stairway seems to go on without end.  After every few steps, you come to another stone landing where the way continues at a sharp angle.  The air is warm and humid, and a feeling of closeness presses in on you.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: The trees are few here, and the largest is barely more than a sapling.  Spiky bushes clump together in splotches, a large group forming a thicket to the east.  A hill rises up to the southeast, the bushes thinning out as the land rises.

title: [Upper Trollfang]
description: You reach the summit of the hill and enter an alpine meadow.  The expanse of short grass suggests that a flock of shopai usually graze here, and indeed have grazed here recently, but the rich pasture is empty.  A crooked gray shack stands on one side of the meadow, barely more than a lean-to.  Shepherds should shelter there during this time of year, but it too is deserted.

title: [Tree Statue]
description: You find yourself at the foot of a giant tree, which towers over your head rising about fifty feet into the air.  It is shaped in the form of an elf dressed in feathers with arms outstretched in front of it, holding something you cannot quite make out from here.  The forest surrounding the area is strangely silent except for the wind, which sings softly as it moves through the treetops above.

title: [Tree Statue, Arm's Cradle]
description: The view from the arms of the statue is breathtaking as you look out across the treetops of the forest which spans for miles.  Looking upon the face of the statue, you sense a calm, giving presence and wonder just whose arms you rest in.  The winds eddy and flow around you as if attracted by the very nature of the majestic figure.  Several long vines drape across the statue's hand.

title: [Twin Canyons, Rockface Slope]
description: Atop the rubble, the western wall contains several cracks and crevices that could easily be used as foot and handholds.  About two hundred feet above, a natural ledge juts out from the wall, a small stream of water flowing over the edge and shimmering like liquid silver as it rains down nearby.  To the northeast the jagged top of the rock outcrop can be seen as well as the rim of the eastern canyon.

Atop the rubble, the western wall contains several cracks and crevices that could easily be used as foot and handholds.  About two hundred feet above, a natural ledge juts out from the wall, a small stream of water flowing over the edge and raining down nearby.  To the northeast the jagged top of the rock outcrop can be seen as well as the rim of the eastern canyon.  The rubble pile appears to be rather stable and the wall appears to be worn from use, not jagged with fresh cracks.

title: [Twin Canyons, Overlook Ledge]
description: Nestled serenely against the western wall, a large coniferous tree grows from cracks next to a small pool of crystal clear warm water.  Vapors dance across the pool while water spills over the rim of the ledge and showers down to the canyon below.  From this vantage and with the illumination of the silvery night sky, the entire canyon is visible to the northeast and beyond, all the way to Darkstone Bay.

From this vantage, the entire canyon is visible to the northeast and beyond that, all the way out to Darkstone Bay.  Sunlight dances across the landscape revealing the lush growth of the Lower Dragonsclaw Plains and the farm land around Wehnimer's Landing.

title: [Frith's Inn, Loft]
description: Shards of shattered glass crackle as you make your way across this loft of the inn, which appears to have been plundered and left unrepaired.  A rope ladder dangles from the skylight above.  There is no longer anything here of value, only cobwebs, rain-warped floorboards and the odor of rotting wood.

title: [Frith's Inn, Second Floor]
description: You are on the second floor of the inn.  As you lean over the polished modwir railing that surrounds the open landing, you see the front room below.  The stairway continues up and down here.  To the east is an oak door and to the west a teakwood door bearing a brass plaque.

title: [Warehouse, Musty Room]
description: A large open area surrounds you.  The musty odor of items stored too long in one place fills the room, and the floor is coated with dust and traces of vermin.  Sacks, crates, and barrels are stacked haphazardly around the room.  You somehow feel uneasy even though it appears that this warehouse has not been active for quite some time.  In the corner, a wooden ladder with a broken rung leads up.

title: [Warehouse, Loft]
description: You are in a loft above the warehouse.  The low ceiling causes you to hunch over.  The floor is spread with filthy straw, as though bedding for a vagrant or squatter.

title: [Wizard Guild, Workshop]
description: The ceiling of the workshop is formed from a solid sheet of blue ice marked with phantasmagorical shapes, but whether they were created by sentient hands or the result of slow melting is impossible to tell.  The glare from the translucent ice above casts a dim, cold blue light on a wide array of alembics, retorts and other materials filling the brass racks that line the walls.  In one corner is a winding brass stairway centered around a solid zorchar rod reaching up through the ceiling.

title: [Wizard Guild, Stair]
description: A warm draft curls up from below as the temperature becomes chilly.  A solid zorchar rod extends from well below the stairway and reaches up into the observatory above.  Viridian and cerulean stained glass windows lining the narrow tower reflect the dim sunlight from outside, making the stairway brighter and casting an amorphous light on the carvings engraved along the polished stone walls.

paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, up, down

title: [Great Cavern, Flue]
description: A wide tunnel extends straight upwards.  Below, the tunnel slopes downward and off to one side a bit.  The ceiling of the flue is covered in thick glowing moss and a drop or two of water falls from above.  The air is still cool here, but well above freezing.

title: [Great Cavern, Limestone Stairs]
description: The stone steps grow warmer as they descend.  The passing of the numbing cold is a welcome change as insensitive feet can easily misstep, but with the new warmth comes another change less welcome.  The stairs are now covered with a thin layer of slime.

title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
description: The cavern continues to the west, but a dark fissure blocks any further progress.  Fumes pour forth in waves, and it takes a moment to recover from their impact.  Fortified with a deep breath and steeled to the reek, the stench is just bearable.

title: [Dark Fissure]
description: Two slabs of stone leave a few feet to squeeze between, and that at an angle that is sure to cause permanent injury to spine and hips if you don't keep moving.  Bursts of air from below carry a searing heat and a stench that would make Onar blanch.

title: [Gas Pocket]
description: This chamber is almost perfectly round except where it is marred by cracks and openings in floor and ceiling.  A powerful stench fills the nostrils.  Whatever foul wizard's breath gathers here, it must be light, for it seems to pool in the ceiling and spark into flame periodically.  The unnatural flashes of lighting illuminate the chamber fitfully.

title: [Dark Fissure]

title: [Mossy Hollow]
description: Tall stalagmites arch above your head, curving to almost meet above you.  They form a pair of rows, bound together with limestone deposits and moss.  You don't recall ever seeing stalagmites bent that way before.  To the north, a dark green opening leads to a lichen-lined tunnel.

title: [Subterranean Island, Large Hill]
description: Murky water stretches into the haze in all directions.  To the south the island curves away in a long rocky spit.  To the north a lower hill rests beyond a row of natural stepping stones.  Moss covers the island from one end to the other.  The top of the hill is split open revealing a mossy cave below.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: An impossible stack of tomes and books piled floor to ceiling leads to a small opening overhead.  Most of the titles are far too worn to be readable, but the few that still peek through the dust of time all bear some reference to wizardry.  It doesn't look as if the mound of ancient leather-bound volumes would hold much weight, yet they are covered by tiny footprints.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A delicate bridge constructed of rose-colored crystal spans the entire keep and leads to a garish tower of coral and shells.  Light glittering off the bridge's glassy surface reflects so brightly that it is difficult to look at for any length of time.  The bridge has been built with no visible seams or flaws and appears crafted from a single gemstone of gigantic proportion.

The bridge has been built with no visible seams or flaws and appears crafted from a single gemstone of gigantic proportion.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, down

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Four flat boulders dangerously support a legless desk and provide what looks to be a very unsafe method of reaching the upper level.  Considering how badly the desk is wobbling just from the faint breeze, it's hardly going to be an easy climb.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Four arrow slits have been cut into the tower wall, but their placement is much too low for the average person to use.  As low as the slots might be though, it hasn't stopped the seabirds of the island from using them for nesting.  Each of the holes is filled with a woven mixture of dried grass, palm fronds and dead seaweed.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: Leaning up against one of the walls is a long slender plank.  The wood is cracked from top to bottom and it doesn't look particularly sturdy.  Near this makeshift ladder, one of the roundish stones used in the wall has been scrawled on with some crude graffiti.  It's difficult to make out, but it looks as if it might be a picture or drawing of some sort.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: The crystalline bridge spanning the top of the keep is a fragile contrast to the outlandish tower it leads to.  Crafted entirely of rose-colored crystals, it looks as if the slightest weight might shatter the entire construction, yet the solid coral spire it holds must weigh tons.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, down

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A stack of rotting crates piled in one corner appears to be an unsafe method of gaining the upper level.  The wood is pitted and moldy, numerous splinters and cracks marring the surface of the wood.

title: [Thurfel's Keep]
description: A small protrusion on the outside of the keep provides an ample perch for the small orange bird roosting upon it.  The beak of the animal is nearly as large as its body, and it is rather comical to say the least.  The feathered critter doesn't seem to be terribly concerned with any of the outside noise or distractions.

title: [Tower Approach]
description: As the trail comes in close proximity to the huge oak tree dominating the landscape, it fades into nothing other than scattered stones.  At the foot of the monster tree is a long platform.  A steep flight of stairs gives access to the ledge, which stands higher than a giantman.  Wings branch from either end in southwest and southeast directions, following the circumference of the tree.

A steep flight of stairs gives access to the ledge, which stands higher than a giantman.  Wings branch from either end in southwest and southeast directions, following the circumference of the tree.

title: [Maaghara Tower]
description: Crafted of polished oak planks, the ledge is both wide and long, spanning the front of a huge oak tree.  The bark covering the colossus is rough and as black as coal.  Overhead, contorted branches as thick as a mammoth jut out in all directions, blocking out all direct sunlight.

title: [Adventurers' Guild, Foyer]
description: Heavy oak posts define this large, octagonal room.  Dominating the center of the space is a massive fireplace, its dressed basalt blocks rising into the dimness of the vaults overhead.  An odd assortment of people is seated on benches scattered around the room, some sitting singly, others in small groups huddled in private conversation.  A staircase winds behind the chimney, leading to the upper story.

title: [Adventurers' Guild, Office]
description: Layers of overlapping, thick wool carpets cover the floor of this spacious room, presenting a bewildering range of styles spanning the primitive geometrics of Tehir to the subtly shaded hues of Loenthra.  At the far end of the room stands an ebony desk inlaid with intricate marquetry, while closer to the stairs leading down, several leather chairs are gathered around a well-tended fire in the stone hearth.  Heavily shuttered windows allow only a few stray beams of light into the comfortable dimness.

title: [Gyldemar Forest, Outpost]
description: An oak of wide girth, its trunk a stony grey hue, rises from the thick forest undergrowth, its skeletal branches oddly absent of leaves.  Its once sturdy bark has turned brittle, flaking off in long strips which litter the path.  Short stubby branches extend from the trunk in a seemingly intelligent pattern, almost appearing as footholds for ascension.  A heavy odor, like the scent of moist earth in swampy regions, pervades the area.

title: [Outpost, Warped Cabin]
description: Split and warped from a drastic change in the shape of the tree which holds it, the one-room cabin creaks and shudders from even the slightest movement within its ragged confines.  Gaping holes, torn open from branches which at one time supported the weight of the small structure, rend the walls.  The wooden flooring is blanketed with dead leaves and an odd assortment of feathers.

title: [River's Rest, Town Commons]
description: Fresh green grass, green as the greenest emerald, is soft underfoot and a pleasing foreground for a weathered wooden bench resting in the shade of a graceful willow tree.  Chirping crickets fill the air and mingle with the voices of folk who stroll through the commons, and on occasion stop to exchange a tale or two with friends they meet along their way.  A dusty path to the south and a riverstone walkway to the north are joined by a tall evergreen hedge which borders the edges of the lawn.

title: [Willow Tree, Platform]
description: Moonlight filters through the dense foliage of the willow tree, illuminating the platform.  The rough-hewn oak planks that form the platform are clearly old ship's timbers.  They are slightly curved and retain a faint odor of pitch.  Twigs and windblown leafy detritus are stuck in the cracks of the planks.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Lobby]
description: Spacious and airy, the lobby of this small island inn welcomes the weary traveler.  Tucked away in the far corner of the room, a simple wooden staircase spirals up, out of sight, to the second floor.  Casual groups of comfortably worn sofas and chairs are scattered about.  At the base of the staircase, a jovial innkeeper stands behind a massive counter, passing out keys and keeping an eye on the lobby.  Occasional bursts of laughter filter in from the archway to the north.

title: [River's Rest Inn, Narrow Hall]
description: Many plaques and paintings adorn the walls here as light from ceiling windows reflect down on them.  An elegant oak staircase leads up to an open balcony of the upper floor.

title: [South River Road, Waterfall]
description: The waterfall violently empties into the Tempest River here, tossing up billowing clouds of water vapor.  The moonlight glints off each individual droplet, filling the air with dancing pulses of light.  One might think it relaxing if it weren't for the deafening roar of the waterfall filling your ears.  Peeking out from behind the falls you see some stone steps carved into the face of the cliff, leading upward to the plateau above.  A road also follows alongside the river to the southwest.

title: [Tempest Falls, Landing]
description: The steps pause at a landing of sorts behind the waterfall.  Only inches from the edge of the landing, the water falls rather noisily from above.  Any further progress up the steps is impossible, as the rushing water blocks your way.

title: [Krol Ship, Hold Amidships]
description: The hold is a bit brighter here due to the moonlight filtering in through the cargo grate high above.  Several large casks are stacked beneath the grate.

title: [Krol Ship, Hold, Casks]
description: You find yourself precariously balanced atop a stack of several large casks, but well within reach of the cargo grate above you.

title: [Citadel, Outside]
description: To the east you can see a huge old oak tree and to the west, the windowless walls of the old building.  The walkway continues to the north and south and seems to be in somewhat better shape than elsewhere.

title: [An Ancient Oak]
description: This branch is about as high as you can go, since the next one appears to be about 8 feet over your head.  It's not a particularly comfortable spot, as the branch you're standing on is only about 2 feet thick.  Far above, you can see an armored skeleton impaled on a broken branch.  It's hard to imagine how it got up there, much less managed to impale itself horizontally on the branch.

title: [Alchemist, Secret Junction]
description: A narrow corridor branches north from this winding, torch-lit hall.  Dense smoke and rock dust hang heavily in the still air, stinging eyes and throat alike, and a monotonous dripping sound echoes down the passage from somewhere to the west.  Above the nearest torch is a small grate, but if it once served to ventilate the hall, the earth and rubble pressing against the grate from the far side now prevent it from serving its function.

title: [Alchemist, Hidden Stair]
description: Each narrow stone step bears several smudged footprints, which are marked in coal dust and barely visible within the shadowed stairwell.  A gilded handle offers better leverage to open the concealed stone door at the top of the stair.  Angular runes have been etched along the outer wall, spiralling down into darkness along with the steps.

title: [Cavern, Waterfall]
description: The ceiling of the natural chamber rises high above your head.  The north wall forms a steep slope, smoothed by the wide cascade of water that flows down its surface and disappears into an underground stream.  Looking up, you can see a space of light near the top of the wall where the fall originates.

title: [Cavern, Ledge]
description: You are balanced on a small ledge which is jutting out from a soft waterfall which forms the north wall.  Below is the cavern floor and above you can make out the edge of a chamber.  From here you can see more hand-holds which can get you to the top.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Headland]
description: The grasses grow singularly tall on this part of the headlands, creating a sort of golden screen that nearly conceals a house-sized boulder that emerges from an earthen mound.  The southward path slopes down to a series of low seaside bluffs.  The waves on the beach below are an eerie green in the moonlight.

The southward path slopes down to a series of low seaside bluffs.  On the dark beach below sandpipers dart back and forth, dodging the incoming waves as they feed.

title: [Maelstrom Bay, Headland Boulder]
description: A wide vista can be viewed from the top of the boulder.  To the west all of Maelstrom Bay and the great western sea spreads out before you.  To the north and east, obscure in the gloom of night, are the rolling hills of the Shattered Moors.  To the south the land dips down into darkness.  A moonlit tower rises beyond the marsh to the southeast.  Some small bones are lodged in a crevice of the boulder.

A tower rises beyond the marsh to the southeast.  Some small bones are lodged in a crevice of the boulder.

title: [Millah's Fen, Stream Bank]
description: The remnants of a cobbled stone road emerge from a wide stream and climb over the bank in the direction of a rocky hill.  The hill stands tall and alone, its rock-strewn sides covered in moss and patches of brown grass, rising out of the patchy fog, oblivious to the surrounding flat fens and marshes.  Pale, gnarled sycamores bend over the stream and surround the area with moss-draped ghostly white forms.

title: [Millah's Fen, Lookout Hill]
description: Stars fill the night sky, their light reflected faintly by a sea of fog surrounding the hilltop.  A soft glow far to the south marks the location of River's Rest and silhouettes a lone tower.  Intermittent bursts of light illuminate an omnious keep to the east, while the silence of the night air carries the sound of a distant sea to the west.  Weathered and moss covered, a stone chair is set facing the west in the center of the hilltop.

An island above the swirling fog, the top of the hill offers an endless view of the surrounding geography.  Far to the west, a blue strip represents the Great Western Sea, while to the east, an ominous stone keep emerges from the fog.  Farther to the south is a blue-roofed tower and beyond it, the minarets and towers of River's Rest.  Weathered and moss-covered, a stone chair is set facing the west in the center of the hilltop.

title: [Cottage Garden, Stone Building]
description: Clean wood shavings cover the floor of this one room building and several mounds of dried grass line the back wall.   The cozy scent of oak, modwir and grass wars with a faint underlying smell of goat.  An oak bucket rests next to a milking stool in one corner of the room and a watering trough and feed bin in the other.

title: [Stone Building, Attic Loft]
description: Piles of straw and dried grass completely cover the floor of the upper story of the stone building.  The exposed wooden beams and slanted roof of the barn form a low ceiling overhead.  A ladder descends down to the floor below.

title: [Old Ta'Faendryl, Basilica Plaza]
description: A tower rises up in the center of the city.  Perched atop its massive height is an octogonal shaped building.  Wide stone steps lead up the side of the pyramid.

A tower in the form of a terraced pyramid of successively receding stories rises up in the center of the city.  Perched atop its massive height is an octogonal shaped building constructed of gleaming white marble.  Wide stone steps lead up the side of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, First Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the west of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

Positioned above all the single story buildings of the city, it is possible to see the damage that time has wrought.  Several blocks to the northwest a tall, dark tower pokes its tip above the cracked and crumbling walls of the surrounding structures.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, Second Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the south of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the platform below.

title: [Basilica Platform, First Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the southeast of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps leads further up the sides of this pyramid.

Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.  Another set of steps lead up to the second story of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, Second Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the east of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the platform below.  Another set of steps lead up to the third level of the pyramid.

Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, Second Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the east of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below.
A gleam of water can be seen to the north where a wide, muddy river running from the east spreads into a shallow lake.  Wide stone steps lead down to the platform below.

title: [Basilica Platform, First Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the north of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below. Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below. Another set of steps lead up to the second level of the pyramid.

title: [Basilica Platform, Second Level]
description: The irregular shadows of night darkened ruins spread out to the west of the pyramid.  Wide stone steps lead down to the streets below. Another set of steps lead up to the third level of the pyramid.

To the west of the pyramid, a long straight road running between a series of massive statues leads to the city walls.  Wide stone steps drop down to the platform below. Another set of steps climb up to the third story of the pyramid.

title: [Canyon, Gecko Ledge]
description: A faint breeze blowing up from the river adds a hint of moisture to the air, but the craggy rocks and sparse trees on the ledge are dry.  Several small lizards cling to the rock wall of the canyon, their faded brown color almost blending into the reddish stone.  A steep trail winds up the canyon wall.

title: [Canyon Ridge, Garden]
description: Hiding among the lush transplanted tropical plants and prickly cactus are a wide variety of lizards.  Multiple species of iguanas, anoles, geckos and other reptiles scurry about, basking in the sun or munching on leaves and bugs.  They seem to have little fear of the two-legged creatures visiting their home, regarding you with a total lack of care.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, up, down

title: [Canyon, Dragon's Ridge]
description: Sparse grasses and rocks cover the expanse between the red stone ridge and the steep trail that leads down the canyon wall to the west.  Several large spiny lizards wander along the top of the ridge, scurrying after bugs or reclining lazily in the sun.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Bluff Face]
description: A ring of cottonwood trees shelters quaint houses nestled beneath their boughs.  Here and there, beams of light break through the mist, shining down in stark rays which coax drops of dew to glisten.  A bluff rises from the sandy loam, its face incised with a course of steps cut into the granite in a lazy curve that offsets the steep cant.  Above, a rooftop or two can be glimpsed through the thick mantle of trees.

title: [Lough Ne'halin, Lakeview Bluff]
description: The elevation of the cliff offers a panoramic view of the lake, with the mist-cloaked castle hulking at the far end and a pencil thin tower rising out of thick fog to the north.  Oaks dominate the ridge, with pine trees tucked around the feet of the taller trees with their lacy foliage of needles.  The scent emanating from cottage hearths mixes with the aroma from the pines in a fresh, spicy perfume.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Vestibule]
description: The polished mahogany of the high, arching ceilings in this chamber is a stark contrast to the alabaster stone of the reinforcing ribbed vaults.  Dangling from the center vault is a gleaming chain of silver links, suspending a softly glowing globe of crackled glass.  A silver-threaded tapestry hangs next to a spindly black willow table that is pushed against the wall.  Opposite the entry door, the area widens considerably to allow space for a dramatic staircase of silver-flecked white marble.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Great Hall]
description: The vaulted ceiling of the hall rises to a spectacular height, and the smooth stonework is punctuated by elongated oval skylights that admit slanting rays of moonlight.  Natural light combined with the candles burning amid dozens of filigree sconces set into the walls causes the ivory-veined grey marble floor to gleam.  Soft velvet curtains in various hues of blue and grey drape the northern wall and are tied back in the center to display a polished granite arch.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Atrium]
description: Pearly moonlight streams in through the glass walls and ceiling, picking pale blossoms out of the shadows formed by the lush vegetation.  The rich fragrance of tropical blooms rises in the night air, along with thin wisps of mist from the wide oval pool.  Occasionally, the chirping or clicking of a nocturnal insect adds music to the quiet setting.  Barely visible in the corner is a spiraling silver staircase, and a pair of glass double doors lead outside to the grounds.

Thriving in the direct sunlight, lush vegetation and a myriad of exotic blooms bedeck the solarium in tropical elegance.  In the center of the room is a wide oval pool.  A panoramic view of the manor grounds lies beyond the glass walls of the space, and a spiraling silver staircase is partially hidden behind a cluster of palm fronds in the corner.  Framed by an arch of ivy bearing crimson trumpet blossoms, a pair of glass double doors leads outside.

title: [Silverwood Manor, Observatory]
description: A short wrought iron railing encloses this space, which is little more than a flat tower roof.  Open to the night sky above, the expanse of the heavens appears without limit.  A polished oak table holds a few charts, which are open and held down with glass paperweights.  A long divan covered in pale blue linen provides a comfortable place to rest, and a copper-banded spyglass sits upon a silver stand, ready to observe the night sky.

Several large books sit closed upon a polished oak table next to a stack of rolled-up charts.  A long divan covered in pale blue linen provides a comfortable place to rest.

title: [Small Airship, Cabin]
description: A large window bordered with crimson eahnor allows an unfettered view of the surroundings on nearly all sides - the massive bow of the ship being directly in front of you.  A large pattern is inscribed upon the mute grey wood of the deck, the contours of the silver coalescing into an arcane design.  A semi-circle of comfortable velvet cushions surrounds a translucent dome set into the center of the design, its surface humming faintly with power.

title: [Small Airship, Below Deck]
description: The small winding staircase comes to an end here, revealing the luxurious, spacy room that spreads out before you.  A low-set maoral table stands in the middle of the room, its reflective surface mirroring the gentle wind-like patterns incised upon the walls.  Soft crimson carpets hide nearly all of the lustrous grey wood, their dark tones matching the curving contours of the dark velvet couch set before the table.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: White limestone mixes with the tower's dark foundation from its base to its crown and is a marked sign of renovation to the ancient premises.  Against the outer wall, a stone stairway spirals upward towards four landings and is wrapped by dark ebonwood banisters.  Above the stairway, daylight trickles across the eight crenellated points, outlining new and old stone work, some of which glints with foreign metal.

White limestone mixes with the tower's dark foundation from its base to its crown and is a marked sign of renovation to the ancient premises.  Against the outer wall, a stone stairway spirals upward, its course illuminated by bracketed torches and interrupted by four landings.  Above the stairway, the roof of the tower has been removed to expose the night sky and all eight crenellated points have been repaired.

title: [Solhaven, Beacon Tower]
description: Glossy ebonwood banisters, lacquered and etched with mystic runes, wrap the stairwell as it climbs from the base of the tower to the highest landing.  A wide shelf juts outward from the limestone tower walls over an arch that leads to a repaired room.  Gone are the torches of yore, their scorch marks upon the smooth walls the only testament to their existence.  In their place are strange globes holding dancing lights of lime green, which flicker and sputter sporadically.

title: [Geyser Flats, Columnar Basalt]
description: The trail stops at the foot of a ridge formed of columnar basalt.  Rectangular fingers of stone reach up toward the sky like square tubes of a primitive pipe organ, their dark surfaces tinged in places with bright sienna.  Crevices in the stone make climbing the ridge possible, however easier trails lead off in other directions.

title: [Geyser Flats, Plateau]
description: Beyond the top of the bluff, another flat, stone plateau surrounds geyser holes and vivid blue pools of water.  Steam rises from some of the reservoirs, marking the location of hot springs.  The stone underfoot is stained with bright bands of color, dyed by the constant barrage of minerals carried in the clouds of condensation, drifting across the vista like an indistinct herd of ghostly behemoths.

title: [Stone Steps]
description: The steps are steep and they twist up the cliff's face in a lazy S-curve like the trail of a snake climbing a desert dune.  Along the cliff-side of the flight, knobs have been carved in the form of sand devil heads that support a rudimentary handrail crafted of teak.  The rail passes through the sand devils' bared teeth, leaving one to worry that the monsters will at some point grow tired of their burden and spit the rail out.

title: [Stone Steps]
description: At this junction of the dizzy flight of steps, the way splits.  To the northeast, the steps continue to climb toward a platform cut into the cliff wall.  This appears to be an entrance into a large dwelling perched atop the ramparts.  To the south, the steps pass over a chasm between the cliff face and a beautiful building constructed on the pillar rising from the foot of the precipice.

To the south, the steps pass over a chasm between the cliff face and a beautiful building constructed on the pillar rising from the darkness of the canyon floor.  Torches stuck into gouges in the wall offer enough light to make a fairly safe climb.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Gate House]
description: You are in a cylindrical chamber carved from the stone of the mountain.  Prominent in the center is a large, stone chair with an iron chest next to it. Against the east wall is a raised platform, about 20 feet high, with a wooden battlement on top.

You are in a cylindrical chamber carved from the stone of the mountain.  Prominent in the center is a large, stone chair with an iron chest next to it.  Against the east wall is a raised platform, about 20 feet high, with a wooden battlement on top.

title: [Melgorehn's Reach, Battlement]
description: You are on top of the battlement platform.  It seems this defensible position was actually used to protect a large, wooden wheel which juts halfway out of the east wall, rather than to cover the person sitting in the chair below.

title: [Beldrin's Game Hall, Larder]
description: This is the larder where food and drink served in the gaming hall are stored.  An open window near the ceiling reveals a patch of sky, but it is too high for you to reach from where you now stand.  Casks of wine and ale are stacked almost to the rafters, leaving you little room to maneuver.  A stairway leads down.

title: [Beldrin's Game Hall, Storeroom]
description: You are perched precariously atop a stack of casks.  You see the floor of the storeroom beneath you.  The ceiling is so close you can touch it and the open window is within your reach.

title: [Wizard Guild, Foyer]
description: Towering above the surroundings and set into an arched niche is a well-polished white marble statue of an elf in flowing robes, a pair of sweeping ivory-hued staircases circling around her.  Twin banners flutter to the left and right of the statue -- the one upon the right bearing the crest of House Illistim and the other bearing the insignia of the Wizard Guild.  Warm amber light flows from the landing at the top of the stairs, playing across the flawless balcony in shimmering waves.

title: [Wizard Guild, Chamber]
description: Crimson eahnor is worked in intricate designs upon the dark grey marble floor, the gleaming metal's surface set afire by the numerous orbs of warm amber light hovering in mid-air.  A small arched door, a dark onyx door, and a dark steel door break up the monotony of the north wall, while the southern end of the chamber leads to a spiral staircase that ascends further up into the tower's reach.

title: [Wizard Guild, Chamber]
description: Crimson eahnor is worked in intricate designs upon the dark grey marble floor, the gleaming metal's surface set afire by the numerous orbs of warm amber light hovering in mid-air.  A small arched door, a dark onyx door, and a dark steel door break up the monotony of the north wall, while the southern end of the chamber leads to a spiral staircase that ascends further up into the tower's reach.

title: [Wizard Guild, Nexus of Elements]
description: The half-translucent surroundings of crystal are marked with a variety of flowing runes, their wavy forms casting four distinct hues of light across the wide, cavernous surroundings.  A single black tome sits atop a dark onyx podium, its pages rustling ever so slightly with brief drafts of air flowing in from the east.  A small marble staircase leads into the upper sections of the tower, the faint hums of power from above reverberating around the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, down

title: [Small Estate, Foyer]
description: Long, thin ivory columns encircle the room, marking the borders of a round disc of pure white marble, its surface streaked with veins of pale crimson.  A deep crimson rose serves as a central mural upon the lustrous marble, its dark petals crafted of thick stained glass.  A sweeping staircase adorned with rich velvet rugs leads further up, while hallways branch off to the east and west.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out

title: [Small Estate, Landing]
description: The white marble tile is partially obscured by a round carmine rug, its curves matching the interior of the room and the slightly domed ceiling above.  A circle of ivory doors surround the area, each traced with a different trailing pattern of ebony.  A pair of stained glass doors leads out to a quaint balcony, their panes spilling a soft carmine light from beyond the threshold.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Steam]
description: The area is in a constant state of shifting haziness as whorls of stifling hot steam eddy in thick clouds and rise toward the ceiling.  The surrounding walls are slightly curved, allowing droplets of moisture to accumulate upon the wavy patterns incised upon their crystalline surfaces.  At the far end of the chamber is a swirled triple-tined vent, its interior releasing howling bursts of steam every few moments.  Identical steps lead upward into both west and east walls.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Fire]
description: The crystalline walls are melted into frozen rivulets in this chamber, and held within them are roaring flames that slither along the walls like sinuous serpents of an endless inferno.  Engulfing the entire chamber and held at bay by a small measure of translucent crystal, the heat from the fire washes across the chamber in hazy waves, blurring and contorting the air about the room.  A set of steps descends down through the center of the room's floor.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, down

title: [Nexus of Elements, Steam]
