At the far end of the chamber is a swirled triple-tined vent, its interior releasing howling bursts of steam every few moments.  Identical steps lead upward into both west and east walls.

title: [Nexus of Elements, Water]
description: Waves of pale cerulean wash over the surroundings, the walls holding currents of water that flow in twisted rivulets, the torrent held back by the translucent crystal.  Sparks of dark luminescence briefly flare to life amid the swirling streams of water, fading in and out of existence like the dark eyes of an aquatic beast.  A faint roaring sound echoes in from the west, and droplets of watery mist dance in the air.  A set of steps descends down through the center of the room's floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, down

title: [Citadel, Vault]
description: As cold as this chamber is, you'd think you were in Icemule, not Ta'Vaalor.  Stairs lead downward into the darkness.

title: [Citadel, Icehouse]
description: A single sconce illuminates the room, but it is woefully inadequate.  A row of wooden tubs is lined up against one wall, the water looking anything but comfortable.

title: [Citadel, Icehouse]
description: A single sconce illuminates the room, but it is woefully inadequate.  A row of wooden tubs is lined up against one wall, the water looking anything but comfortable.

title: [Citadel, Darkroom]
description: There is but a single candle burning, and all it reveals is a room no larger than a closet.  A shelf holds several clear glass bottles, odd shapes writhing and twisting within them.

title: [Warrior Guild, Entrance Hall]
description: A light sifting of dust covers the terra cotta floor, apparently tracked in from the courtyard beyond the double doors.  Lanterns hung from sconces along the whitewashed walls protect the candles within from the cool night breeze which moves through the unglazed windows.  Corridors lead off to the east and west, their beamed ceilings only slightly higher than a tall giantman's head.

title: [Warrior Guild, Second Floor]
description: Windows lining every wall of the expansive upper story provide ample light and a good view of the guild's grounds.  The view is the only feature of note, as the room is bare of furniture or decoration.

title: [Cleric Guild, River's Rest]
description: Onyx columns gleam in the light of myriad beeswax tapers which surround two central statues.  Each of the figures is cut from pale stone, as is the inscribed base on which they stand.  There are no windows, but the high arc of the domed ceiling keeps the chamber from feeling too enclosed.  An aged oak door is set between two onyx columns, and deep blue carpets, their patterns almost obscured by constellations of jasmine petals, muffle the steps of passing priests.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, west, northwest

title: [Cleric Guild, Aviary]
description: Gilded mesh encloses a piece of the sky, and you are surrounded by birdsong. Parrots flash their brilliant colors amidst the branches of potted trees, the birds' cries a raucous counterpoint to the trilling of plainer, but more eloquent larks.  The aviary's wire walls permit smaller birds to come and go, but even the fenvaoks seem content with their eyrie above the guild.

Gilded mesh encloses a piece of the night sky, and you are lulled by soporific birdsong.  Owls continue their low-pitched inquiry of the nightingales who sing amidst the branches of the potted trees, but the raucous parrots and fenvaoks are asleep.  The moons seem nearer and worldly matters much more distant from this eyrie.

title: [Rogue Guild, East Courtyard]
description: The wood and stone back walls of the surrounding buildings form a spacious, elongated courtyard that extends to the west through the middle of the block.  Most of the snow has been cleared away by the constant passing of trampling feet, and a few hardy evergreen vines add spots of green to the grey and brown of the frosty walls.

title: [Icemule Trace, Rooftop]
description: The nondescript rooftop is covered by a blanket of snow broken only by the quickly fading outlines of several sets of footprints leading off to the north.  An old ladder propped against the back of the building leads down into a narrow courtyard.

title: [Wizard Guild, Observatory]
description: Most of the spacious chamber is taken up by a massive brass orrery, the various moons and planets crafted from enamelled metal.  A silver telescope is pointed upwards towards the heavens, its surface holding a pristine shine.  Detailed and precise paintings of the constellations adorn the walls.  A large fissure in the stone ceiling provides the telescope an unobstructed view of the heavens.  Steps descend into a very narrow cleft cut in the rock.

title: [Wizard Guild, Steps]
description: The narrow channel feels as enclosed as a chimney and is almost as sooty.  The rock walls around you are uncomfortably warm to the touch, and the widely spaced torches shed little light on the seemingly never-ending steps.

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Alchemy Nexus]
description: Wind whips through the open air stone room, the scent of the sea thick in the air and accompanied by the sound of crashing waves.  Five platforms extend from the immediate area and beyond them in all directions lies an endless expanse of dark water.  A glimpse over the edge of the platform reveals its location atop a great stone tower anchored in the sea, hundreds of feet above the surface of the water.  In the center of the platform stands a pillar, behind which descends a staircase.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Sorcerer Guild, Storage]
description: Far cooler than the outdoor platforms above, the room is dimly lit by two feeble candles placed on two large wooden stands opposite each other by opposing walls.  Much of the wall space is covered in large wooden shelves and a series of cabinets replete with many small wooden drawers.  A few inches of dust cover much of everything, including the floor, revealing a number of tiny clawed footprints.

title: [Albatross, Cashier]
description: White alabaster and dark mahogany flooring are cleverly conjoined into the image of a giant roulette wheel.  Heavy tapestries hang from the walls, each depicting gamblers winning at different games.  Some shallow steps lead down into the roulette pit that are position between a gold-trimmed rosewood door and an expansive mahogany archway.

title: [Albatross, Roulette Pit]
description: Richly paneled walls and lush crimson carpeting are illuminated by myriad candles behind hunter green glass, but the focal point of this pit is the elaborate roulette wheel on a polished mahogany table.  The numbers chart, betting sign, and rules poster are all framed in gold and hang from the rosewood walls in easy view of all gamblers.

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Lobby]
description: Sconces line the walls of the rectangular, granite-floored room, each set upon a narrow marble column that reaches up and supports a high ceiling.  A large torn banner is draped down one wall and set behind a simple black marble altar placed in the center of the room.  Five narrow archways, draped with dark red velvet curtains, lead off from the chamber into adjacent rooms.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest, west

title: [Cleric Guild, Alchemy Storage]
description: The circular chamber is built of dark granite with the exception of white marble used to outline the ribbing of a vaulted ceiling.  The room is mainly bare with only a few stacked crates flanked on one side by a large dust bin and on the other by a wooden footlocker.  An archway, outlined with the same marble as the ceiling, leads off into another room.

title: [After Thoughts, Amidships]
description: Moonlight trickles in from outside to provide a small measure of visibility.  A corroded copper ladder is revealed, recessed in the lone interior wall.  Beside the ladder, a deteriorated black ash door leads towards the bow.  The exterior walls are badly weathered, and the copper-framed windows set within them have not held glass in ages.  Flexing precariously underfoot, a wooden deck creaks and groans with each step.

Sunlight pours in through five large glassless, copper-framed windows set within the boat's badly weathered exterior walls.  A corroded copper ladder is recessed in the lone interior wall, leading up.  Beside the ladder, a deteriorated black ash door leads towards the bow.  The wooden deck creaks and flexes precariously underfoot.

description: A section of the floor has fallen away, forming a ramp leading down to the main deck. title: [Feywrot Mire, Banyan Cirque]
description: Tall tufts of drying grasses tickle the deeply furrowed, grey bark at the base of a stately black gum.  The vibrant, purple leaves of the gum confirm the autumnal grip on the land.  Cheery music and the smells of frying food drift in on the occasional breeze from nearby.  Several colorful wagons, each painted with various deformed animals, create a semicircle around the gum.

title: [Feywrot Mire, Treehouse]
description: Painted panels of leftover planks of wood have been nailed together to form the floor of this cramped treehouse.  Draping canvas overhead provides some shelter from the elements.

title: [Abandoned Stronghold, Rotunda]
description: The stone structure, perhaps once serving as a military garrison, has been claimed mostly by the Feywrot Mire.  Old stairwells leading below are completely filled with swamp water and muck, offering no chance to explore the depths of the fortification, but a pitted iron ladder hangs from the ceiling leading up.  A rusted iron armor stand rests in the center of the room, with weapon racks surrounding it upon each wall.  Seemingly out of place, a corroded iron footlocker is pushed up against some rubble near the exit.

title: [Abandoned Stronghold, Turret]
description: The top of the stronghold is no more than a crumbling crenallation, a shadow of its former glory.  Overlooking the Feywrot Mire, the view isn't as spectacular as it could be, given the overgrowth of the swamp blocking much of the scenery.  Several dog-faced gargoyles are perched on the turret, as if they were mounted to protect the stronghold.

title: [Dreadnaught Alliance Courtyard]
description: Secured by a massive stone wall, this spacious courtyard is a welcome retreat.  A deep fire pit encircled by black stones fills the area with warmth.  An old, dried-up cobblestone well sits alongside a stone bench.  Posted near the gigantic drawbridge is an oak signpost staked into the ground.  A massive gnarled oak tree with grey threadlike moss hanging from its branches rests in the midst.  A winding cobblestone path guides travelers to the torch-lit stairs, the entrance to the Dreadnaught tavern, and beyond.

title: [Temple of Reunification]
description: This pure golden ora-plated temple holds eight glorious tapestries bearing the crests of the Great Elven Houses.  The centerpiece of the room is a slender mithril case securing an ancient elven crown atop a gold pillow, which is encircled by carving on the floor below that reads, "For The Day Eight Houses Become One."  In front of the open window overlooking the Elven Empire, a white stone table surrounded by eight seats has been masterfully hand-crafted and polished to a reflective sheen.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Foyer]
description: Black obsidian walls, polished to a sheen that nearly matches that of the tall silver mirror that stands at the west end of the foyer, rise to the vaulted ceiling thirty feet above.  A gracefully curved staircase of black marble winds along the walls, leading upwards into the higher reaches of the tower.  Dark banners emblazoned with symbols of the Dhe'nari castes hang high on the walls, and a set of double doors carved of black ora opens to the south.

title: [Obsidian Tower, Stairway]
description: The open staircase hugs the wall, providing a dizzying view up into the heights of the tower.  The stair stops at a small landing at which several doors are set into the stone wall, then continues up in a steep spiral.  The glossy obsidian steps are each set with a slightly raised rolaren symbol that provides a safe grip on the slick stairs.

title: [Silvergate, Hallway]
description: Muffled footsteps and voices from the floor above filter through an air grille high on the end wall and echo in this wide hallway.  It is sparsely furnished, boasting only a wooden bench set opposite a tanned leather curtain which rustles in a draft.  A sturdy iron-reinforced door bars your way to the north.

title: [Silvergate, A Small Landing]
description: Muffled voices from the lounge barely reach your ears here.  Dimly lit, there is still enough light for you to make your way.  A narrow staircase leads down to the lower levels of the manor.

title: [Bard Guild, Entry Hall]
description: Just beyond a heavy wooden door leading back out onto the street lurks a warm, if not exceptionally spacious hallway with walls and ceiling of raw timber graced here and there by golden musical notes.  Several oil lamps hang from the beams, providing small pools of golden illumination leading to a little shop occupying a nook in the western wall.  The sounds of music drift upward from the darkened depths of a broad curving staircase, occasionally punctuated by bursts of laughter.

Snow is packed tightly between thick wooden support beams, creating a cocoon of warmth inside the snowdrift.  Several oil lamps hang from the beams, providing small pools of golden illumination on the packed snowy floor.  The sounds of music drift upward from the darkened depths of a broad curving staircase, occasionally punctuated by bursts of laughter.

title: [Bard Guild, Landing]
description: The narrow staircase pauses at a landing where the stairs crook around a curve.  To the northeast, an arch takes the place of the carved panels decorating the other walls.  A pair of bas-relief masks hangs on the lintel of the arch, one with an exaggerated grin and the other a tragic grimace.

title: [White Haven, Greenhouse]
description: Roses of every color bloom beneath a crystal dome, forming an elegant border for the rows of herbs being tended by a halfling gardener.  Lilies, jasmine and lavender create an ordered riot of pastel around a circular stone path.  In the center of the path stands a bubbling font of pristine melt-water, its quiet sound a peaceful counterpoint to the garden's stillness.

title: [White Haven, Hot Springs]
description: Warm steam from a sapphire blue pool fills the room.  The cold from outside is blotted from memory as the radiant warmth begins to sink into your bones. Some low, rounded cedar ottomans cluster around a small stone-bordered pond, the lush vibrancy of potted sirenflowers offset by the pale water lilies floating on the pond's surface.

title: [Dragonspine, Mountainside]
description: A wide precipice on the side of a towering mountain is buffetted by howling gusts of wind and clouds of snow.  Hidden partially behind a large boulder are the top rungs of a sturdy iron ladder.

title: [A Narrow Shaft, Ladder]
description: A few snowflakes dance through the air near the top of the ladder, and the freezing wind howls mercilessly.

title: [A Twisting Tunnel, Shaft]
description: The curving of the tunnel walls stops suddenly in this tiny space that is flooded with light.  Far above, an opening can be seen that reveals a tiny round patch of sky.  A sturdy iron ladder, bolted into the cave walls, leads up.

title: [A Narrow Shaft, Ladder]
description: The smooth walls of this shaft are slick with ice, and the temperature is almost unbearably cold.  Wind howls down from the opening through the shaft, shaking the ladder slightly.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]
description: It is very dark and cold here, and the steep stairs are very slippery.  A dull light shines from the top of the staircase.

title: [A Dark Cave]
description: The staircase ends abruptly in a large, round room that is freezing cold.  Torches clamped to the walls burn with odd blue flames, highlighting rusty shackles that are attached to the rough walls.  One set of shackles still holds a pitiful skeleton covered in scraps of tattered cloth.  A pointed archway in the wall leads out.

title: [A Dark Tunnel, Staircase]

description: A crumbling torch, affixed to the wall with iron clamps and burning with a strange white flame, illuminates the initial steps of a very steep staircase, unevenly cut from the rough stone of the tunnel.

description: Lined with tiny glass chips, their patterns on the floor create a bright mosaic whose colors sharply contrast the dark wooden walls. A large heated pool ripples along the length of the room, beautiful azure tiles coloring the bottom.  A crimson curtained arch leads out of the room, while three white stone stairs descends into an azure-tiled pool.

title: [Caldarium, Pool]
description: Deep azure tiles line the floor and walls of the recessed pool creating a pattern that fans out from darkest to lightest.  The heated water coupled with the warm air caresses the skin, soothing the sorest of muscles.  Three white stone stairs lead up to the room above.

title: [Bathhouse, Frigidarium]
description: Tall glass windows allow sunlight to slip in through the thick foliage outside.  Stone steps lead down into a small pool, large enough for swimming.  An indigo curtained arch keeps the chilled air inside the room, cooling the water, while a polished oak door stands partially closed for the same reason.

title: [Frigidarium, Pool]
description: Chilled water fills the deep stone pool that fits into the length of the room.  Large enough to swim laps, the pool adds cool refreshment to the other workouts available in the guild.  Two stone pillars carved into a pair of swords mark the steps leading back up.

title: [Duskruin Arena, Foyer]

description: This large, open room is filled with successively higher rows of polished ebonwood benches, supported at each end by heavy, dragon-shaped legs of cast silver. At the front of the room is a large dais, behind which the Ord an Dragan standard is displayed.

title: [Baile Dragan, Library]
description: The air in this dimly lit room carries the scent of parchment and leather.  Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves are packed tightly with thick tomes and parchment scrolls.  The most valuable volumes are located on a rack above a long study table, each fastened securely to a rod with a length of chain.  Oil lamps burn brightly on several reading desks equipped with inkwells and quill pens.  Two comfortable chairs and an overstuffed leather sofa create a cozy reading nook for more casual study sessions.

title: [Baile Dragan, The Wyrm's Rest]
description: Hazy with smoke from the wood fire and redolent of ale and other spirits, this spacious room is a gathering place for local residents.  In the center of the room, a fireplace with an immense circular hearth provides wanted warmth in winter and a cook-fire year round.  Tables and benches run the length of the room on opposing sides of the fireplace, with more at either end, and the floor is strewn with fresh rushes.  Bundles of fragrant herbs and bottles of brew line the shelves behind the serving counter

title: [Baile Dragan, Cellar]
description: A cool temperature makes the cellar at Baile Dragan an ideal storage area.  The room is filled with kegs of ale and cider and racks of bottled wines, some labeled with the finer vintages of decades past.  Neatly stored in the room are sacks of potatoes and root vegetables, armor and weapons, and other sundry goods necessary for the running of such an establishment.  A small niche is outfitted with a wooden table, a wash tub, and an iron brazier.

title: [Oak Tree, Dark Hole]
description: Dangling from a perch constructed at the tree opening above your head is a thick knotted rope.  Since the wooden pegs inside the tree have all but disappeared, this appears to be the only way to continue upwards.

title: [Oak Tree, Wooden Perch]
description: This well-constructed perch has been situated half inside the tree and half outside.  An ornate carved railing surrounds the edge in a half-moon shape, providing protection from falling.  From this height, the ground is not visible at all.  All you can see is green leaves and branches to all sides.  Off to one side of the perch is a sturdy oak ladder leading up to another platform.

description: Atop this gigantic tree, an oak platform has been constructed.  A colorful array of flower petals is scattered over the floor, occasionally whirling about the air whenever a gust of wind rushes through the tree top.  Spread about the platform are several benches, providing ideal locations for contemplation and reflection.  Near each bench is a handcrafted wicker basket filled to the brim with petals.

title: [Reim Settlement, Courtyard]
description: Stone walls tower above the path leading up to a long stone stairway.  A carved ironwood planter box filled with freshly tilled soil sits by the stairway with a variety of oak-handled garden tools discarded beside it.

title: [Reim Settlement, Barbican]
description: Alternating in height, the stone walls of the barbican are carved with narrow slits set in equal distances apart.  Neatly piled next to each wall opening is a pile of bolts and arrows with thick, green fluid dried to the tips.

title: [Bard Guild, Landing]
description: The landing is a convergence of two flights of stairs, where the turn of the steps has been enlarged to accommodate a large palm and a teak bench.  From a terra cotta urn standing in one corner comes the peaceful sound of bubbling water.  An arch occupies the east wall, through which one can see the upward slope of an elevated walkway.

title: [Bard Guild, Winding Stairwell]
description: The curving stairwell widens at the foot of a window, its view partially obstructed by heavily carved wooden screens.  Beyond the screens lies a panoramic vista of quaint rooftops and minarets, and in the distance, the sparkle of moonlight on water.  An arched doorway is discretely set in a small alcove produced by the stairway's turn, and from inside, the clink of glass and delicious aromas extend an invitation to come within.

title: [Bard Guild, Fest Hall]
description: The Bard Guild Fest Hall is an expansive chamber, tiled with dark grey stone beneath the dark teak paneling of the walls.  Overhead, the ceiling is high, allowing mid-day heat to rise above the chamber's inhabitants, and giving headroom to the double rows of massive palms potted in likewise monumental urns.  Teak tables and comfortable-looking black leather armchairs provide a minimal, and strikingly elegant, tableau.

A stairway leads down with barely enough light to illuminate the carpeted stairs and curved wooden banister, and from below, strains of music drift up in disjointed fragments, like spirits climbing out of the depths.

title: [Bard Guild, Fest Hall]

Groupings of chairs and stools sit in an array, overshadowed by a large, circular sofa occupying the room's center.  An imposing carved marble bust overlooks all, perched on the pedestal created by the plush sofa's crimson velvet back-cushions.

Occupying the eastern wall, a marble-mantled fireplace is surrounded by a whitewashed haon door on one side and a linden-edged white door on the other.

description: Luminescent green moss lines the slick stone walls of this small chamber and provides adequate lighting despite a lack of windows or candles.  Thin pathways between various sized containers and tables impede navigation to a beaded curtain.

title: [Scrip Shop, Upstairs]

Heavy, hole-ridden sheets of green velvet loosely cover a series of pristine wooden crates, the fabric pooling across the knitted rugs covering the dusty planks.  A pair of driftwood-carved sculptures flank a gilt-painted curio in the far corner, the open doors draped in a fine layer of brittle cobwebs.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Order]
description: Providing egress to both the floor above and the one below, a golden linden spiral staircase dominates the center of this circular landing fashioned of alabaster stones.  Gauzy curtains of translucent white are bound in golden rings to create a cloudy-like halo that encircles a round west-facing window.  Five bright white globes dangle from the ceiling, their dormant interiors points of darkness in the sunlight.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Apex]
description: Rising from a perfect hole in the granite floor, a spiral staircase spills into the room amid a halo of five golden mirrors that reflect the moonlight in all directions.  Alabaster, carnelian, aventurine, onyx, and azurite tiles form half circles upon the floor, their open-ends facing matching half-circle archways that lead towards illuminated balconies.

title: [Needle of Pentas, Chaos]
description: Ebon tiles, speckled with rainbow-hued mica, are fitted amongst oddly shaped onyx slabs to form the floor and ceiling of this compact chamber.  Golden chains descend from the ceiling to support obsidian bowls that are filled with fire, their flickering light creating chaotic patterns upon the reflective walls.  Moonlight invades the space via a round east-facing window and casts its silvery light upon a golden linden spiral staircase that offers passage to the upper and lower chambers.

Blown glass orbs, five in total, encircle a simple, spiral staircase, while a viridian and agate bench pays homage to a round southeast-facing window.

To the southwest, a round window is framed with blue opal cabochons, while the center is filled with an ascending and descending staircase.

description: Large and small blocks of granite transition from rose to crimson within this small chamber, the gradient hues becoming pale enough to be nearly white in one section, while the opposite section is nearly black.  Star-shaped stained glass lanterns dangle from the ceiling around a golden linden spiral staircase that leads both up and down.  Beneath a southwestern-facing window, a cushioned bench of sanguine and mauve provides a comfortable resting place.

Towering archways, five in total, are evenly spaced throughout, their hazy openings glowing with a dim light.  Five teardrop-shaped lanterns dangle from golden chains around a central, spiral staircase that ascends to the floor above.

title: [Higher Thinking]
description: The smooth, unevenly spaced driftwood that comprise the walls of this poorly constructed shack give evidence in both sight and smell of ages spent in or near the swelling sea; indeed, bits of sand and dried muck cling desperately to the occasional dent in the wood of several of the logs.  Through gaps in the walls, you hear waves crashing eternally in rhythm with the unabating buzzing of big bugs.  The ground below is formed of a mixture of crushed seashells, sand, and other unidentifable substances.

description: Through wide gaps in the wooden planks of the floor, you notice patrons milling about and overhear their soft chatter as they examine their wares. title: [Just For Kicks]
description: In front of a long wooden counter, faded and threadbare rugs are scattered over a hard-packed dirt floor.  Various cobbling tools hang from nails and spikes driven into oaken walls, while an assortment of broken shoe forms are piled high in one corner beside an open battered trunk.  A broken crate sits at the foot of a narrow staircase leading to a small loft.

title: [Just For Kicks, Storage]
[Just For Kicks]
description: Crowded with broken furniture and discarded shoeboxes, a small space has been cleared around a dye-splattered tub.  A long-tailed sewer rat is perched on the edge of the tub, the rodent's feet stained an odd shade of blue.  Near a small window, a wire basket hangs from a low ceiling riddled with holes.

title: [Faire of the North, Rime Wall]
description: The packed snow of the footpath ends here at a tall stone wall covered in hoarfrost.  Just in front of the wall, patches of icy, indigenous flowers are bordered by crisp-leafed teaberry and bearberry bushes.  Ice-glazed moonflowers in a rainbow of colors are clustered in round mounds of ice-frosted earth.  The occasional falling snowflake perches on a flower here and there, long enough to give a brief twinkle before fading away.

title: [Elementary Elementals]
description: A cramped cavern opens up with a dirt floor and a slick, icy ceiling.  Patches of dirty, clumped snow that have escaped the drifts above or were knocked down the hole and through the shop's entrance have been trampled upon and muddied even further by the heavy feet of perusing shoppers, but remain frozen thanks to the freezing temperature within this concealed shop.

title: [Sylvanfair, Vestibule]
description: Square in shape, the vestibule is bathed in a shaft of muted gold sunlight streaming through the open top section of the front door.  A richly carved staircase rises from the terracotta-tiled floor, cantilevered against the four walls to provide a perfect viewing platform for the irregularly shaped table that dominates the center of the room.  Mismatched cabinets and battered trunks fill the asymmetrical spaces beneath the stairway, crammed with assorted timekeeping devices and navigational instruments.

title: [Sylvanfair, Loft]
description: Built into the sloping roof space, the galleried loft is naturally illuminated by open-shuttered windows set between narrow oak rafters.  Each pane offers an unimpeded view of the freeport and beyond with the use of an imflass telescope.  Brick walls on either side are filled with astral maps and cluttered shelves.  Clear of furniture, a deep blue woolen rug covering the floor provides a suitable blank canvas for four metal lanterns suspended overhead.

title: [The Librarium, Study]
description: The ground floor of this little structure resembles a study, its many shelves overflowing with aged tomes and scrolls.  Within a glass case, three books sit on special display, while on a shelf beside them rest sheaves of neatly organized papers.

title: [The Librarium, Sanctuary]
description: A small altar lends this sparse and serene space the air of a sanctuary.  Upon its surface rests a trio of books, while atop some pillows sit many sheaves of papers.

title: [The Librarium, Laboratory]
description: Beakers and vials of viscous fluid bubble atop a work table in what resembles a laboratory.  Within a summoning circle on the floor, three tomes sit on display, while sheaves of papers surround them atop some pedestals at all points.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Hall]
description: Dazzling moonlight streams in through a deep, narrow window cut high on the eastern wall, causing the moonstones set into the polished onyx floor to glitter and sparkle like stars against a nighttime sky.  A tall spiral staircase rises from the center of the chamber, each step inset with a single perfect white opal.  The clink of glassware and sounds of easy camraderie drift up a passageway to the southeast, and a marble arch leads down into a great chamber to the west.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest

title: [Tower of Liabo, Balcony]
description: Moonlight streams through narrow windows, causing the alabaster walls to glow brilliantly.  A small set of crystal chimes suspended in one of the windows spin and sway in the chilly breeze, occasionally brushing against each other with clear ringing notes.  The huge circular main hall is visible over a simple wrought iron railing, and accessible via a narrow staircase that spirals down.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Hall]
description: A set of stairs leads down into darkness, the silver and onyx elegance of the main hall giving way to rougher stone as they descend, curving with the outer wall.  A dark marble arch on the inner wall faces a narrow spiral staircase leading up to the balcony above.  A single black doomstone adorns the end of each polished rail of the staircase.

title: [Tower of Lornon, Balcony]
description: Gleaming bricks of smooth black onyx reflect the light from a wall-mounted vaalin lamp.  No window disturbs the flame and the lamp's unwavering glow suffuses the air, which is noticeably heavy and still.  A narrow staircase leads back down to the main hall, and enclosed corridors stretch off to the north and southeast.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Hall]

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Cellar]
description: None of the elegant splendor present in the rest of the abbey exists in this dank cellar.  Greenish-grey lichen flourishes on the damp fieldstone walls, barely visible in the light provided by a single sputtering oil lamp set in the south wall between a mithril barred door and a cracked modwir door.  A set of granite stairs curves upwards along the western wall, warm candlelight filtering down from above.

title: [Moonstone Abbey, Great Hall]
description: Towards the center of this vast circular chamber, the gently curving granite wall is interrupted by a dark marble arch leading into an expansive auditorium.  A vast library is visible through a passageway to the north, and a narrow staircase spirals upwards, rubies inset all along the handrail.

title: [Tower of Tilaok, Balcony]
description: Several pewter sconces blaze along the red-veined marble wall of this semicircular landing.  Glinting in the light, a platinum railing stands at the balcony's edge, and a narrow spiral staircase twists down into the great hall, the single handrail studded with crimson rubies.

title: [Tower of Tilaok, Roof]
description: Blocks of deep crimson marble shine eerily in the moonlight, grey veins winding across them sinuously.  Across the huge dome to the south, the opposing towers of Lornon and Liabo contrast sharply with each other, one a pale moonlit spire, the other barely visible against the nighttime sky.  A large altar crafted of the same type of marble stands in the center of the platform, a thick scarlet leather tome resting on its surface between two tall tall blood red candles.

title: [Tower of Lornon, Roof]
description: A chill breeze whips across the summit of this narrow onyx tower, seeking every opening in your clothing.  Unwavering in the wind, two slender black candles rest atop an obsidian altar, on either side of a massive tome encased in polished ebonwood.  Dark forests wreathed in mist cover the hills like a verdant carpet in all directions, surely old when the abbey was built.

title: [Tower of Liabo, Roof]
description: Pale alabaster glistens everywhere atop this slender edifice, almost painful in its brilliance.  Directly south, a sparkling lake spreads across the shallow valley, patches of fog drifting across it like clouds sailing across a peaceful sky.  In the center of the tower rests a simple white marble altar, untouched by carvings or decoration, save for two slender white candles on either side of a large tome bound in silvery-white eonake.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Atrium]
description: The rising steps level into a tiled floor sheltered beneath a velarium of heavy onyx-hued fabric on a latticed metal frame.  Unable to weather the unrelenting gusts that seige colosseum at times, the cloth is badly frayed at the edges, thin strings left loose and tangled, while rents in the canopy reveal the crimson sky above.  A trio of pillars support the velarium, while the rear slants back directly into the cradle of the stone wall.  This leaves the view from three sides almost entirely unfettered.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Influx]
description: The sky above is broken and stained a menacing crimson hue, with lightning spearing across at intervals to illuminate the massive, bruised clouds against the ruddy backdrop.  Nothing of the incongruous heavens is solid or sure, though the ground is stable enough, black sands scattered deep over hard-packed earth.  A portal stands at the rear of the arena, corkscrewing within a frame set directly into the wall, its viridian mists chased by violet arcs of energy that charge the air with the scent of ozone.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Atrium]

Despite the ill condition of the colosseum at large, this open air atrium is relatively unscathed, offering a secluded repose high above the arena.  Braziers of wrought iron stand beside each support pillar, and the embers within burn with an unnatural red-violet glow.  A small niche is recessed into the rear wall, while a few stone benches sit in the center of the floor.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, War]
description: Sporadic eruptions of lightning paint the uneven columns of the arena in a stark, monochrome palette and causes them to throw fitful shadows across the black sand underfoot.  Across the field, the only deviation to the continuous black is the occasional flash of white.  Closer examination reveals a femur here, a jawbone there, and it is soon obvious that nothing that survives here leaves whole, evidenced both by the remains left in haphazard repose and the shattered sky above.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Atrium]
description: The rising some shallow steps level into a tiled floor sheltered beneath a velarium of heavy onyx-hued fabric on a latticed metal frame.  Situated in the center of the atrium is a massive stone throne, its facade weathered yet still impressive with its sheer size and elaborate carvings.  Squat wrought-iron braziers sit on each side, their red-violet embers caged behind an iron shield pierced by cutouts that throw unnatural light across the fabric overhead, each shape a yawning maw exhaling ghosts of crimson flame.

title: [Arena of the Abyss, Pestilence]
description: Arranged among the travertine risers, spectators are seated, a scattering of fleshless skeletons that sit, heads lolled back or forward or to the side, while some are missing entirely.  The tattered remains of clothing cling to their bony forms, whipped at by errant winds that for brief moments breathe some measure of life into the long-dead corpses.  They, like the arena itself, remain, persisting against the tumultuous elements that rule this place, weathering the chaos and disarray with perseverance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, up

title: [Ziethsmet's Home, Entry]
description: Brilliant white walls give way on one end to a polished floor of interwoven teak and cedar, while the other end supports a stucco ceiling fitted with tiny frosted glass globes.  Decorative paintings are arranged along a solid wall that shares its space with an open stairway, while the other three walls are fitted with enormous floor-to-ceiling windows of painted glass.  A series of settees and chairs are scattered about the space, each positioned to face an extremely low linden table.

title: [Ziethsmet's Home, Bedroom]
description: Fully open to the stairs, the tidy bedroom serves as both sleeping quarters and an artisan's crafting space.  While the right half of the room is filled with a small bed, a plain footlocker, and a simple armoire, the left is almost cluttered with a floor-to-ceiling bookcase that houses several porcelain pieces of artwork, various painting jars, and a collection of paintbrushes.  An easel, its canvas splattered with paint, sits in a lone corner and has a nest of frosted glass globes suspended over it.

title: [Wandering Eye Market, Northeast]
description: Thick blue-green grass attempts to invade the painted cobblestones of the market, their tall blades swaying in the light seaborne breeze that carries with it the scent of dog roses and mulch.  Tanner's stalls and leatherworker's booths are evenly spaced from one another, each tilted at an angle to view the other.  Parked back against the towering cliff wall that stretches into the sky, a large wooden wagon painted black and silver has its door thrown wide open, while a chest-shaped calligraphed sign and a sturdy oak ladder are lashed to its side.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest, west

title: [Wandering Eye Market, Wagon Top]
description: Surrounded by a steel railing, the wagon's roof is spacious and affords a panoramic view of the Wandering Eye Market.  Positioned side-by-side, a large wastebasket and a sturdy wooden table rest along the eastern edge, the railing rising above them by several handspans.  A ladder bolted to one side provides easy egress to the cobblestones below.

title: [Guard Tower, Office]
description: Hanging from wrought iron wall anchors, pot-bellied glass and blued steel lanterns maintain a comfortable brightness throughout the tidy office during all times of the day and night.  Various papers, signs, notes, and maps are tacked to a large bulletin board that is hung over a simple wooden desk and its matching chair.  A cast iron stove, its chimney piped out of the southern wall, occupies one corner of the space, while a rough oak ladder leads to the second floor.

title: [Guard Tower, Armament]
description: Built beneath a conical shelter, the eastern side of the roof is devoid of a wall and has only a narrow railing that prevents a fall to the ground below.  The northern wall has an enormous opening, where a large ballista sits at the ready and is flanked by several narrow-framed openings that provide clear views of the road beyond the small colony's open front gates.  A small hatch is bolted open, providing access to a ladder that leads to the first floor.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Refectory]
description: Occupants of the hall move in and out, tasting the many delicacies offered on a trio of massive, short-legged tables that extend the full width of this cavernous hexagonal room.  Four archways provide entrance to the meeting chambers, from whence the perpetual sounds of debate and discussion can be heard.  Drinks are served at a bar to the east and a small shop resides through a low passage under the main stairway.  To the west, an alcove has been cut into the rough, grey stone wall.

title: [Kharam Dzu Hall, Stairway]
description: Short flagstone steps curve east to north from the hall's entrance and widen significantly as they drop to the floor of an expansive refectory.  Four statues, depicting a sand devil, a siren lizard, a thrak, and a pyrothag, rest upon heavy bronze pedestals set back into the smooth, grey stone walls on either side.  Yellow-green light filters from above and below, dimly lighting the stairway as it reflects off the walls.

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Kitchen]
description: The warming aromas of drakefern tea and bittersweet chocolate add cozy appeal to the expansive eating area.  A round-bellied cast iron stove, a rectangular steel sink, and a sleek silver-woven bin are spaced evenly apart within the dark granite counters.  A tiger maple butcher block is securely bolted down in front of a hand-turned maoral dining table, allowing hosts the chance to interact with guests while cooking.  A narrow stairway nearly mirrors the same upward ascension of a flight of steps opposite of their placement on the back wall.

title: [Emberglaes Hearth, Bed Chamber]

Suspended from the ceiling, a six-tiered rainbow glaes chandelier casts kaleidoscopic colors across the fiery crimson damask bedding that is piled with satin cushions and thick furs.  Obscured on a far wall, a set of obsidian-inlaid stairs is fixed next to a roll-top carved mahogany desk.

title: [The Lighthouse, Stairwell]
description: Upon entering the stairwell you spy the massive spiral iron stairs that climb the lighthouse tower.  The terse sounds of footsteps and thunderous conversation echoes down the stairwell and out through an arched opening.

title: [The Lighthouse, Stairwell]
description: A platform fashioned from iron and timbers marks the halfway point of the stairwell.  Muffled sounds of conversation seem to come from behind a modwir door and echo around the stairwell chamber.  A small window opposite a brass-framed alcove provides a vantage point that overlooks the bay.

title: [Tippy Toes, Living Quarters]
description: A pair of high-backed chairs separated by a low table huddle in front of a dark stone fireplace, the dying embers of a fire glowing within.  Along one grey-striped, papered wall sits a sturdy oaken sideboard with open drawers, its contents neat and orderly.  Tucked away beneath a narrow stairway, wooden bins full of colorful bits of fabric are nearly hidden from view.

title: [Tippy Toes, Upstairs]
description: A long worktable complete with a pair of shoe forms takes up most of the space in the loft.  An open footlocker containing a variety of tools and cobbling supplies sits at the end of a neatly made, narrow bed.  A small, round window lined with frost overlooks the courtyard below.

title: [Rub-a-dub-dub, Entry]
description: Water seeps from sandstone block walls creating murky pools on a packed dirt floor, while a variety of basins and tubs collect water dripping from the high ceiling.  Draped from a thick beam overhead, a canvas tarpaulin shields a grey driftwood cabinet, keeping the linens within dry.  A clothesline is strung from an aged oak mantel, a pair of socks dangling just beyond the reach of the flames from a modest fire.

title: [Rub-a-dub-dub, Stairway]
description: Warped and rotting from constant water damage, the spiraling stairway winds up and up to a trapdoor in the ceiling overhead.  A collection of glass jars and clay pots are stacked on narrow shelves that line the sandstone walls, while myriad tubs, basins, and buckets hang from some rusty hooks.  Torches lighting the stairway splutter and sizzle as water droplets threaten to cast the treacherous flight into darkness.

title: [Sylvanfair, Guardian Hall]
description: A display of ornate tapestries line the expanse of bare grey stone walls, rising from the tiled floor to the tie beam of the high vaulted ceiling.  Although spacious and airy with tall mullioned windows, the room feels cozy due to the inglenook fireplace taking up most of the back wall and the large oaken table and benches running down the middle.  In the far corner, shadowed by the overhanging gallery, stands a graceful harp and small stool, awaiting an adept to fill the hall with music and song.

title: [Sylvanfair, Solar]
description: Bright sunlight floods the room through a tall mullioned window, illuminating the antique silk rug covering most of the tiled floor.  Three grey stone walls, hung with pastoral murals, enclose the space beneath a high vaulted ceiling, while a curved linden balustrade overlooks the hall below.  Tall cabinets filled with books and curios line one wall, in front of which sits a writing desk and a high-backed chair.  Two sofas face each other across a low table set for entertaining.

Pale moonlight floods the room through a tall mullioned window, illuminating the antique silk rug covering most of the tiled floor.  Three grey stone walls, hung with pastoral murals, enclose the space beneath a high vaulted ceiling, while a curved linden balustrade overlooks the hall below.  Tall cabinets filled with books and curios line one wall, in front of which sits a writing desk and a high-backed chair.  Two sofas face each other across a low table set for entertaining.

title: [Vornavis, Dondraek Lane]
description: Slowly transitioning from a residential area to the south, the northern section of the avenue that follows the line of the Vornavis-Solhaven wall becomes less densely populated.  Lampposts are more prevalent amid the tidy storehouses and customs houses, which are surrounded by wagons in various stages of being loaded or unloaded.  A set of cobbled stairs rises towards the gated entry into the sister city.

title: [Vornavis, Gate of the Tradesmen]
description: Known colloquially as the Tradesmen's Gates, a wide stone structure juts out from the copper-faced doors that interrupt the tall Vornavis-Solhaven wall.  Cobbled stairs to the south and north ascend to the bustling warehouse district of the imperial city, where refracted light bounces off of lanterns that are strung up on the avenue below.  Fuchsia-footed wandering sailor, a local ivy, climbs the walls, finding purchase in the ancient mortar between the stacked stone blocks.

title: [Rumor Woods, Racing Entries]
description: Pennants placed every few feet along a widening muddy track provide a colorful escort to a pair of viewing stands on opposing sides of a sodded racing track.  Centrally located, a sky blue and white-striped pavilion buzzes with activity as jockeys prepare for upcoming races.  A supply cart pulled by a team of stout ponies is unloaded of its burden near the entrance.

title: [Rumor Woods, Viewing Stands]
description: Constructed from hardy oak and stained a golden honey color, narrow benches set on risers run the length of an elevated stand overlooking a dirt racing track.  Padded fleece cushions are strewn about the seating area, offering slight comfort and minimal warmth.  Mounted along the front rails, hunter green pennants whip and snap wildly in the cool breeze.

description: Raised several steps above the ground, the sturdily constructed stands overlook a deeply rutted racing track.  Several of the benches have collapsed under the collective weight of the crowds, the splintered oak boards now only fit for kindling.  Strands of embroidered black-on-crimson pennants line the steps leading down to the racing entries.

title: [Rumor Woods, Tourney Booths]
description: On opposing sides of a dirt racing track, a set of vert-painted steps and a set of violet-painted steps lead to corresponding banner-draped viewing stands filled with raucous crowds.  The soft ground has been trampled by foot and hoof alike, a thrown silver horseshoe stuck in a water-lined mud puddle near a shorn tuft of sweet grass.  A thicket of beautyberry bushes provide a scenic background for a collection of booths.

description: Painted with splashes of beige and myrtle green, it is standing room only at this end of the race track viewing stands.  Covering the oak plank floor, a mixture of confetti and sawdust is used to soak up the spilled ale from which a constant sour odor rises.  An enormous stuffed scorpion pierced through the eyes with a white arrow hangs above a set of steps leading down from the stands.

title: [Rumor Woods, Viewing Stands]
description: Overlooking a dirt racing track, multitier plank benches painted bright beige are packed into an oak constructed stand raised above ground level.  Silken beige banners are draped at all corners, while myrtle green streamers featuring jerboas flutter from sturdy wooden railings.  The smell of roasting peanuts and freshly popped corn wafts through the seating area.

Overlooking a dirt racing track, multi-tier plank benches painted bright crimson are packed into an oak constructed stand raised above ground level.  Silken ebon banners are draped at all corners, while crimson streamers featuring various wolf silhouettes flutter from sturdy wooden railings.  The smell of roasting peanuts and freshly popped corn wafts through the seating area.

title: [The Brass Ring, Carousel Center]
description: A prime representation of gnomish artisanship, the inner workings of the carousel are laid bare behind the finely painted scenery panels in a jumble of gears, levers, and moving metal parts.  Amid bins overflowing with tools and barrels full of black grease, an old monir chariot has been repurposed into a bed for the operator.  A spiraling stairway winds around the enormous center pole supporting the roundabout, leading to a storage area above.

title: [The Brass Ring, Storage]
description: A small herd of carved wooden horses in various states of disrepair are crowded into a makeshift corral taking up most of the available storage space above the carousel.  Leather reins and tarnished bits hang on oak-paneled walls on both sides of a cedar cabinet filled with evenly spaced shelves.  Suspended from the low ceiling by lengths of faded velvet, myriad brass rings, each polished to a mirror shine, reflect the flickering light cast from a pair of lanterns mounted near the stairway.

title: [Academy Keep, Great Hall]
description: Towering walls of fitted stone line this spacious hall, arcing inward near the top to form the vaulted ceiling above.  Shredded tapestries and faded wall-hangings of purple and gold hang in tattered streamers from the walls among long ribbons of dust-laden spider's webs.  Tables and chairs, splintered and unserviceable, are piled in a large heap near the arch, while a sideboard, still draped in old festival streams, leans precariously near a small passageway cut into the rear wall.

title: [Keep Tower, Stairwell]
description: Slabs of carved grey granite set in a spiral traverse this stairwell, wide enough to carry whole groups of people up and down the generous steps.  Small slit windows allow for a glimpse of the countryside, as slender beams of pale light barely illuminate glittering mica in the stone.  A fine layer of dust hangs over the thick iron chain that has been bolted to the walls, lending the area an unkempt appearance that is at odds with the view from the windows.

title: [Emberthorn Refuge, Nook]
description: Sheltered by a dense canopy of verdant umbrage, an elevated wooden platform affords an expansive view of the surrounding landscape, the western edge guarded by moss-covered trees resembling green giants with wrinkled bark faces.  A polished heartwood slab table flanked by a series of high-backed chairs is arranged atop floor mats woven from dried grasses, giving off a sweet aroma.  A seemingly floating staircase leads to a vine-enclosed platform farther above.

title: [Emberthorn Refuge, Platform]
description: Secluded behind drapes of interwoven vines, an oversized, downy feather bed nestled in a cradle of curving branches is situated in the center of a lofty platform overlooking a lush garden.  A near-perfect circular opening in the canopy overhead acts as a skylight, offering a glimpse beyond the verdurous sanctuary.  Thrown over a gnarled branch of a prodigious, hollow-trunk tree, a length of knotted rope dangles over the pooling water of a woodland waterfall below.

title: [Dollhouse, Corridor]
description: Butterflies and daisies paint the white walls with vibrant hues, their tiny designs illuminated by a pair of brightly burning glass globes set at either end of the long corridor.  Sashes laden with pins flank a polished bronze mirror that is hung upon the northern wall, while a small table beneath holds a jeweler's display rack and a cobalt blue blown glass bowl.  A small rug of verdant green muffles the sound of passage leading to a narrow staircase.

title: [Dollhouse, Kitchen]
description: Bright white cabinets hang upon the walls above polished granite countertops, their tiny faces fitted with brass and ivory handles.  Red checkered curtains flank a window that presides over a tiny stonework sink that is filled with miniature cobalt blue and white dishes.  Pantry shelves display a large glass jar filled with eyes, several large cooking pots filled with ears, and a wide porcelain ewer filled with noses.

title: [The TownCrier, Lobby]
description: The lofty open-beamed ceiling provides a glimpse of the second floor newsroom, visible just beyond a sturdy mahogany railing.  Sunlight filters through twin palladian windows flanking the entry, refracting through crystalline glass panes to wash the narrow tanik floorboards.  Opposite the entry doors, a polished mahogany reception counter holds an assortment of refreshments and a small handwritten card.  A twining grapevine fresco follows some curved steps ascending to the open space above.

title: [The TownCrier, Newsroom]
description: Numerous desks in various states of disarray are scattered around the room, covered in stacks of books and papers, the odd bottle of ink perched precariously atop the piles.  Scraps of parchment are clipped to strategically placed contraptions hanging from beams.  A large blackboard is mounted on the west wall between an office and the conference room.  Open wood-framed cubbyholes line the south wall beneath glass-fronted news clippings, some empty, some bursting at the seams with unopened wax-sealed scrolls.

title: [The TownCrier, Rooftop Garden]
description: Offering sweeping views across the town's haphazard structures to the sparkling waters of the bay, the rooftop is furnished with comfortable bench seating encircling a central copper-clad firepit.  An enclosure protects the stairs leading back into the building, a well-worn dart board mounted on its outer wall.  Weathered grey tanik box planters, bursting with fragrant flora, surround the space.  Messenger birds swoop in to rest on a perch, observing the area momentarily before taking flight again.

title: [Witch's Cottage, Garden Path]
description: Delicate fronds of moisture-beaded ferns reach across the gem-lined border of a moonlit walkway as though hoping to caress the legs of passersby.  Dotted around and amongst them are multicolored mushrooms emerging from the rich, dark, and loamy soil.  From a nearby cluster of saplings, crickets lend their voices to the night with a series of plaintive chirps.

title: [Witch's Cottage, Front Porch]
description: Sturdy floorboards of whitewashed oak form a decorative herringbone pattern on the front porch landing of this isolated cottage.  Centered prominently within the cottage's clapboard face is a tall witchwood door.  For as sturdy as the flooring appears, an ominous creaking can be detected whenever anyone nearby approaches the open doorway.

title: [Sleeping Drake Harbor, Ixia Ave]
description: Nestled beneath travertine terraces, a small avenue features the beginnings of a grand staircase that rises towards the cliffs above.  Carved into the stone, the steps resemble the scales of a dragon's back, and a pair of stone statues guards the ascent.  Surrounding the staircase are several vine-covered buildings, their walls adorned with blooming vines and their roofs covered in terracotta.  Clusters of cistus shrubs stretch between a white wooden gate and the open doors of a sturdy stable, their delicate blooms perfuming the air.

title: [Spine of Koar, Legs]
description: Stone steps wind through travertine terraces, rising alongside steaming mineral pools too hot for mortal flesh to enjoy.  The ancient stonework displays the marks of time, worn smooth by countless footsteps.  Carved into the rocky wall, a dragon's claw opens empty and inviting, its scales catching the starlight.  Iron lanterns hang from hooks, their stained glass panels casting vibrant reflections of red, blue, and green onto the travertine surfaces.

title: [Asterlight Athenaeum, Entry]
description: Warm light floods the library, spilling from large-globed lanterns that perch upon railing tops, as well as the surface of a round circulation desk that is attended by a willow-thin human librarian.  Forming a clover-shaped arch over both the entry and exit, a set of staircases fashioned of dark-burled camphor stained a reddish gold hue provide access to the floor above.  Railings and shelves in matching tones decorate the teal walls as they climb towards an enormous iron and glass skylight that is recessed into the domed ceiling.

title: [Asterlight Athenaeum, Tier 2]
description: Curving around the atrium, the second floor frames the grand circulation desk below, its presence marked by a tile mosaic in teal, white, and canary yellow.  Towering bookcases stretch toward the vaulted ceiling, their warm wood tones complementing white wrought iron railings.  Lanterns perch atop the posts, casting dappled light across the floor.  Above, staircases spiral toward the next level, their curves forming a clover arch over a quiet reading alcove nestled beneath its embrace.

title: [Spine of Koar, Hips]
description: Widening slightly, the eastern section of the staircase has a small alcove filled with a stone bench and a large dragon egg sculpture nestled within creeping vines.  Steam from the surrounding travertine terraces cools in the night air, shimmering in the starlight as it dampens the surrounding stones.  Stone steps continue the ascent, their surface carved with scales while opposite, stairs descend towards a small harbor.

title: [Spine of Koar, Back]
description: Traversing a series of grand stone steps, the staircase meanders along the dragon's lower spine, offering sweeping views of the travertine terraces below.  Faintly warm mineral springs flow alongside, their gentle steam rising to the cool air.  Carved details of dragon scales cover the steps, their edges worn smooth by centuries of use.  Ornate iron lanterns, suspended from intricate brackets, cast a soft, ambient light that dances across the terraces' gleaming surfaces.

title: [Spine of Koar, Back]
description: Steps continue along the lower spine of the dragon carved into the slopping terrain, but here, one of the surrounding travertine pools has overflowed, cascading onto the stairs.  Charcoal grey planks span the flooded sections, creating a bridge over the shimmering, mineral-rich waters.  Moisture clings to the planks, glistening in the starlight.  Striations of white, beige, and rust in the surrounding stone highlight natural patterns formed by mineral deposits over millennia.

title: [Spine of Koar, Wings]
description: Steps wind upward, growing narrower as they ascend past jagged rock faces.  A flat expanse on the western wing supports a cafe, positioned directly across the mineral springs and pools that define the travertine terraces.  From the eastern side, a dramatic travertine arch is carved into the flanking wing and curves outward, creating a grand canopy that shelters the small establishment.

title: [Spine of Koar, Shoulders]
description: Winding steps dance across the spine of the dragon carved into the travertine and marl cliff and cut through its shoulders as it climbs past sweeping stone reliefs of a single serpentine arm.  The appendage extends dramatically outward, talons embedded into the cliff's face as if holding the mountain in a powerful embrace.  Delicate carvings highlight the dragon's form, merging with the natural travertine textures that frame the staircase.

title: [Spine of Koar, Neck]
description: Winding upward along the sinuous neck of the dragon carved into the stone, the staircase curves gently away from the cliff face as it ascends towards the head at one end and descends to the shoulders on the other.  Solid railings of dark iron guard against falls as both the eastern and western sides are open to the air.  A majestic view of the dragon's head reveals enormous aquamarine stones set in the eye sockets, their topaz centers glowing like twin suns.

title: [Spine of Koar, Head]
description: From this vantage point, a vast panorama of the island's terraces and distant horizons spreads out for all to see.  Curved and serpentine, the floor resembles the shape of an enormous dragon's head.  Stone steps, meticulously carved into the dragon's neck, wind their way downwards to the distant harbor and an ornate staircase ascends to the cliff's apex.  Ornate iron railings, adorned with intricate dragon motifs, feature lanterns whose colorful glass panes decorate the area in their prismatic light.

title: [Spine of Koar and Pentas Avenue]
description: Serving as a threshold to the staircase and an archway onto the avenue, a pair of imposing sculptures depict a robed woman reaching up to touch the snout of an enormous drake, whose head leans towards her in a gesture of respect.  Intricate gold-veined tiles form patterns upon the surrounding avenue, while travertine planters filled with succulents and white pebbles line the path.  Frosted globes recessed into nearby cypress trees illuminate the avenue.

title: [Melpomene Manor, Entry]
description: White plaster walls frame the entry room, with a smooth staircase ascending gracefully from one corner, its edges seamlessly blending into the wall.  Windows bordered by turquoise shutters feature built-in sitting shelves softened with plump cushions, inviting moments of quiet repose.  A recessed fireplace, flush with the wall, includes a niche above it for decorative accents and a round platform in front, perfectly suited for food preparation or warming small dishes in the cozy space.

title: [Melpomene Manor, Second Floor]
description: Connecting seamlessly to the space below via a smooth staircase, the room is framed by white plaster walls.  Turquoise shutters frame the windows, letting in natural light and adding a vibrant touch to the space.  Near the double doors of teal shutters, which open onto a rooftop veranda, a pair of backless curule chairs has been set.  A bespeckled half-elf agent stands nearby, quietly reading.  Overhead, an intricately carved ceiling beam runs the length of the room, adorned with motifs of tamarisk leaves and blossoms painted in soft green and pink.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: The sounds of rushing water from the spring to the west, the rustle of unseen forest creatures to the north, and an occasional plop, splash and sucking sound from the moat compete for your attention.  The spring's course bends here, disappearing into a thick clump of trees that signals the beginning of a great wood to the north.  Very faintly in the east, you can see pale outlines of peaks.  Dominating the southeast vista, the ruins of the Black Swan hover on the horizon.

The rustle of unseen forest creatures meandering through the trees and the occasional sucking plops and splashes from the disgusting moat subtly vie for your attention.  The spring's course bends here around a solitary modwir tree, disappearing into a thick clump of trees that branch out into the beginning of a dense forest to the north.  To the east, you can faintly see the pale outlines of mountain peaks.  Dominating the southeastern landscape, you can see the ruins of the Black Swan on the horizon.  You also see a rope stretching from the top of a tree and across the moat to the castle.

title: [Treetop]
description: You are securely perched on a fork between the trunk and a stout branch of the modwir.  The foliage is thick enough to obscure your view of the countryside.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: The cool breeze off the mountains in the east offers little respite from the sticky air as you travel along the bank.  The east wing of the castle complex can be discerned, and the pall of the menacing edifice is ever across your path, the jagged gaps atop the ruined outer walls casting sharp, fang-like shadows.  The breeze suddenly shifts, bringing the lapping sounds and rotting water weed smell of the moat to you.  A tall, gaunt structure atop the small hummock due east diverts your attention.

Occasionally though, the wind shifts, bringing with it uncomfortable heat and the rotting stench of the castle moat.  The castle stands broken, yet still forbidding in your sight. The jagged gaps atop the ruined outer walls cast sharp, fang-like shadows across your path.  Due east, stands a tall, gaunt structure atop a small hummock.

title: [Field, Exterior]
description: The mountains to the east taper off towards the south, dense underbrush marking the transition between upland and plain.  The east flank of the castle compound, its walls, and the drawbridge over the moat, suspended in mid-air, are visible from the crest of this small hummock.  The skeletal remains of an old catapult, a fossil of some past siege, stand in the center of the high ground.

The mountains to the east gently taper off toward the south with dense underbrush marking the transition between upland and plain.  The eastern flank of the castle compound and the drawbridge are visible from the crest of this small hummock.  The skeletal remains of an old catapult, an aged fossil of some past siege, languish in the center of the high ground.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Great Hall]
description: Beyond the threshold, the tower opens into a circular chamber of cold stone.  A spiraling stone staircase of the same ancient building blocks as the walls winds upward from the center, coiling patient and deliberate toward the floors above.  An iron railing traces the circumference, and behind it the curved walls rise in bookshelves, broken only by an open stone-ringed archway.  Iron candelabras ring the stairs, their candles casting a low amber light that deepens the shadows rather than drives them out.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Second Floor]
description: White stone walls rise bare along the second level, broken only by wrought iron sconces shaped like curling vines that cradle softly glowing candles and an open door set within smooth masonry.  At center, a spiraling staircase of pale wood treads and cobbled stone risers winds both up and down, a slender iron railing tracing its curve as it dips into shadow below and climbs toward the third level.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Second Floor]
description: White stone walls rise bare along the second level, broken only by wrought iron sconces shaped like curling vines that cradle softly glowing candles and an open door set within smooth masonry.  At center, a spiraling staircase of pale wood treads and cobbled stone risers winds both up and down, a slender iron railing tracing its curve as it dips into shadow below and climbs toward the third level.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Third Floor]
description: Plum velvet drapes sweep along a third of the curved wall, their folds gathered in heavy arcs that soften the stone, while the remaining span is carved into recessed shelving lined with neatly arranged volumes and small curios.  At center, a spiraling stone staircase continues its ascent, pale wood and cobbled stone turning upward toward the fourth level as its iron railing glints in the ambient light.  Flickering light dances along the descending steps, slipping around the curve before fading into shadow.

title: [Spire, Fourth Floor Landing]
description: Set upon a wide landing, a small study has been arranged, its stone kept clean and free of dust, lending the space a quiet sense of care.  Slender arrow-slit windows fitted with panes of sky blue and silver glass filter soft, shifting light across a delicate writing desk and wooden stool.  Fine nicks still mark the frame of the door that stands opposite, though their edges have been smoothed with age and use.  Nearby, a spiraling stone staircase winds both up and down, vanishing into shadow below even as it rises toward the next level.

title: [Sylinar's Spire, Fifth Floor]
description: At rest, a dusty suit of platemail stands balanced against the greatsword it holds point-down before it, its surface kept clean and free of dust.  Across from the armor, a faint chill lingers around an open door, cool air slipping quietly into the space.  Nearby, a spiraling stone staircase winds both upward and downward, continuing toward the sixth level while fading into shadow below.

title: [Pearls Before Brine, Deck]
description: Sheets of patched canvas stretch overhead, forming a sun-bleached awning above a broad, uneven deck.  A rusted anchor chain snakes between overturned crates forming makeshift tables, a variety of trinkets and wares piled on top.  Towards the bow, a pair of skull-shaped iron lanterns illuminate a narrow opening to a steep stairwell that leads down into the cargo hold.

title: [Pearls Before Brine, Hold]
description: Thick with the scent of brine and tar, the hold is cramped, the low beams forcing most visitors to stoop.  Along one bulkhead, repurposed crates have been stacked to form shelves of salvaged goods, while to the stern, a makeshift door crafted from an old hatch leads into a storage alcove stuffed with battered trunks.  A tattered parchment chart marked with red-inked routes lies on a rickety gaming table strewn with candle stubs and empty rum bottles.

title: [Tempest Queen, Main Cabin]
description: Whitewashed and trimmed in gilt, the main cabin is lavishly decorated with turned wood columns and fanciful scrollwork.  Crystal chandeliers hang in a spacious salon flanked by first-class staterooms, while a grand staircase leads to amusements on the upper deck.  Music and laughter spill through a pair of swinging doors.

title: [Tempest Queen, Second Deck]
description: Plush carpet runners muffle the sounds of constant foot traffic between the lounges and entertainments on this level and the main deck below.  Tucked into dimly lit alcoves along the hallway, velvet-cushioned settees invite respite and casual conversation.  On the starboard side, a gilded plaque is mounted on a burnished mahogany door.

title: [Tempest Queen, Smoking Lounge]
description: Reserved for gentlemen, the richly appointed lounge smells of fragrant tobacco.  Opposite a gilded arch, a pair of brass-buttoned dark leather couches faces each other across a low ivory-inlaid table.  A felt-topped gaming table is arranged with a quartet of high-backed chairs, a trolley nearby stocked with playing cards and white jade dice.

title: [Tempest Queen, Upward Deck]
description: Enclosed by a sturdy railing, the uppermost deck of the barge offers an omnidirectional view of the environs.  Huddled in the middle, rows of chaise lounges are kept clear of the promenade area.  A burnished brass signal bell hangs in silence outside of an abandoned pilothouse housing the ship's wheel.
